entry.title: LEGO-MOF: Equivariant Latent Manipulation for Editable, Generative, and Optimizable MOF Design

author.name: Chaoran Zhang, Guangyao Li, Dongxu Ji

entry.summary: Proposes LEGO-MOF, a generative framework for metal-organic framework design using an SE(3)-equivariant VAE that enables continuous structural manipulation in latent space for carbon capture applications.

entry.title: PatchPoison: Poisoning Multi-View Datasets to Degrade 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Prajas Wadekar, Venkata Sai Pranav Bachina, Kunal Bhosikar, Ankit Gangwal, Charu Sharma

entry.summary: Presents PatchPoison, a lightweight dataset-poisoning method that prevents unauthorized 3D reconstruction from publicly available images by injecting small adversarial patches that corrupt Structure-from-Motion pipelines.

entry.title: Red Skills or Blue Skills? A Dive Into Skills Published on ClawHub

author.name: Haichuan Hu, Ye Shang, Quanjun Zhang

entry.summary: Presents an empirical study of ClawHub, a public registry of 26,502 agent skills, analyzing their language distribution, functional organization, popularity, and security risks across skill ecosystems.

entry.title: PersonaVLM: Long-Term Personalized Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Chang Nie, Chaoyou Fu, Yifan Zhang, Haihua Yang, Caifeng Shan

entry.summary: Introduces PersonaVLM, a personalized multimodal agent framework for long-term personalization that extracts chronological multimodal memories, maintains evolving user profiles, and adapts responses to individual preferences.

entry.title: AgentSPEX: An Agent SPecification and EXecution Language

author.name: Pengcheng Wang, Jerry Huang, Jiarui Yao, Rui Pan, Peizhi Niu, Yaowenqi Liu, Ruida Wang, Renhao Lu, Yuwei Guo, Tong Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces AgentSPEX, a specification and execution language for LLM-agent workflows that provides explicit control flow and modular structure, addressing limitations of reactive prompting and Python-coupled orchestration frameworks.

entry.title: ToolOmni: Enabling Open-World Tool Use via Agentic learning with Proactive Retrieval and Grounded Execution

author.name: Shouzheng Huang, Meishan Zhang, Baotian Hu, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Presents ToolOmni, a unified agentic framework for open-world tool use combining proactive retrieval and grounded execution within a reasoning loop, addressing the challenge of massive and evolving tool repositories.

entry.title: Beyond Static Personas: Situational Personality Steering for Large Language Models

author.name: Zesheng Wei, Mengxiang Li, Zilei Wang, Yang Deng

entry.summary: Proposes IRIS, a training-free neuron-based framework for situational personality steering in LLMs, first demonstrating situation-dependent personality patterns in persona neurons then using them for controllable personality adaptation.

entry.title: Interpretable Stylistic Variation in Human and LLM Writing Across Genres, Models, and Decoding Strategies

author.name: Swati Rallapalli, Shannon Gallagher, Ronald Yurko, Tyler Brooks, Chuck Loughin, Michele Sezgin, Violet Turri

entry.summary: Conducts large-scale stylistic analysis of text from 11 LLMs across 8 genres and 4 decoding strategies using Biber's linguistic features. Reveals key linguistic differentiators between human and LLM-generated text.

entry.title: Towards Patient-Specific Deformable Registration in Laparoscopic Surgery

author.name: Alberto Neri, Veronica Penza, Nazim Haouchine, Leonardo S. Mattos

entry.summary: Introduces the first patient-specific non-rigid point cloud registration method for laparoscopic surgery, using a novel data generation strategy to optimize for individual patients with a Transformer encoder-decoder.

entry.title: PAT-VCM: Plug-and-Play Auxiliary Tokens for Video Coding for Machines

author.name: Wei Jiang, Wei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes PAT-VCM, a plug-and-play auxiliary token framework for video coding that keeps a shared baseline stream and adds lightweight task-aware tokens, enabling multiple downstream tasks without retraining codecs.

entry.title: SSD-GS: Scattering and Shadow Decomposition for Relightable 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Iris Zheng, Guojun Tang, Alexander Doronin, Paul Teal, Fang-Lue Zhang

entry.title: CausalDisenSeg: A Causality-Guided Disentanglement Framework with Counterfactual Reasoning for Robust Brain Tumor Segmentation Under Missing Modalities

author.name: Bo Liu, Yulong Zou, Jin Hong

entry.summary: Proposes CausalDisenSeg, a causality-guided framework for brain tumor segmentation under missing MRI modalities that disentangles anatomical causal factors from stylistic bias factors using counterfactual reasoning.

entry.title: VRAG-DFD: Verifiable Retrieval-Augmentation for MLLM-based Deepfake Detection

author.name: Hui Han, Shunli Wang, Yandan Zhao, Taiping Yao, Shouhong Ding

entry.summary: Proposes VRAG-DFD, combining retrieval-augmented generation with reinforcement learning for deepfake detection using MLLMs. Provides dynamic forgery knowledge retrieval and critical reasoning abilities.

entry.title: ReConText3D: Replay-based Continual Text-to-3D Generation

author.name: Muhammad Ahmed Ullah Khan, Muhammad Haris Bin Amir, Didier Stricker, Muhammad Zeshan Afzal

entry.summary: Presents ReConText3D, the first framework for continual text-to-3D generation that prevents catastrophic forgetting through text-embedding k-Center replay memory selection.

entry.title: From Synchrony to Sequence: Exo-to-Ego Generation via Interpolation

author.name: Mohammad Mahdi, Nedko Savov, Danda Pani Paudel, Luc Van Gool

entry.title: ASTRA: Enhancing Multi-Subject Generation with Retrieval-Augmented Pose Guidance and Disentangled Position Embedding

author.name: Tianze Xia, Zijian Ning, Zonglin Zhao, Mingjia Wang

entry.summary: Introduces ASTRA for multi-subject image generation that architecturally disentangles subject appearance from pose structure within a Diffusion Transformer using retrieval-augmented pose guidance.

entry.title: ROSE: Retrieval-Oriented Segmentation Enhancement

author.name: Song Tang, Guangquan Jie, Henghui Ding, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces NEST (Novel Emerging Segmentation Task) for segmenting entities unknown to MLLMs, and proposes ROSE, a retrieval-augmented segmentation approach that incorporates external knowledge for novel/emerging entity recognition.

entry.title: A KL Lens on Quantization: Fast, Forward-Only Sensitivity for Mixed-Precision SSM-Transformer Models

author.name: Jason Kong, Nilesh Prasad Pandey, Flavio Ponzina, Tajana Rosing

entry.summary: Proposes a backpropagation-free sensitivity analysis framework for mixed-precision quantization of hybrid SSM-Transformer models, using KL divergence as a forward-only metric to identify components most susceptible to quantization.

entry.title: BioTrain: Sub-MB, Sub-50mW On-Device Fine-Tuning for Edge-AI on Biosignals

author.name: Run Wang, Victor J. B. Jung, Philip Wiese, Sebastian Frey, Giusy Spacone, Francesco Conti, Alessio Burrello, Luca Benin

entry.summary: Proposes BioTrain, a framework for full-network fine-tuning of biosignal models on sub-100mW MCU-based wearables with sub-MB memory constraints, enabling on-device adaptation for EEG and similar signals.

entry.title: RPS: Information Elicitation with Reinforcement Prompt Selection

author.name: Tao Wang, Jingyao Lu, Xibo Wang, Haonan Huang, Su Yao, Zhiqiang Hu, Xingyan Chen, Enmao Diao

entry.summary: Proposes Reinforcement Prompt Selection (RPS), a lightweight RL framework for eliciting concealed information from users in open-ended dialogues by learning optimal prompting strategies.

entry.title: Towards Unconstrained Human-Object Interaction

author.name: Francesco Tonini, Alessandro Conti, Lorenzo Vaquero, Cigdem Beyan, Elisa Ricci

entry.summary: Defines Unconstrained HOI (U-HOI), a new task removing the need for predefined interaction vocabularies at both training and inference, leveraging MLLMs for open-vocabulary interaction detection in the wild.

entry.title: Boundary Sampling to Learn Predictive Safety Filters via Pontryagin's Maximum Principle

author.name: James Dallas, Thomas Lew, John Talbot, Jonathan DeCastro, Somil Bansal, John Subosits

entry.summary: Uses Pontryagin's Maximum Principle to characterize safety boundary trajectories for guiding data collection in learning-based Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability, improving efficiency of Control Barrier Function synthesis.

entry.title: EmbodiedClaw: Conversational Workflow Execution for Embodied AI Development

author.name: Xueyang Zhou, Yihan Sun, Xijie Gong, Guiyao Tie, Pan Zhou, Lichao Sun, Yongchao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes EmbodiedClaw, a conversational agent that automates embodied AI development workflows including environment creation, trajectory collection, model training, and evaluation through natural language interaction.

entry.title: C-voting: Confidence-Based Test-Time Voting without Explicit Energy Functions

author.name: Kenji Kubo, Shunsuke Kamiya, Masanori Koyama, Kohei Hayashi, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo

entry.summary: Introduces confidence-based voting (C-voting), a test-time scaling strategy for latent recurrent neural networks that selects outputs based on model confidence without explicit energy functions. Applied to Sudoku, Maze solving, and reasoning tasks.

entry.title: Enhancing Reinforcement Learning for Radiology Report Generation with Evidence-aware Rewards and Self-correcting Preference Learning

author.name: Qin Zhou, Guoyan Liang, Qianyi Yang, Jingyuan Chen, Sai Wu, Chang Yao, Zhe Wang

entry.summary: Introduces ESC-RL for radiology report generation, combining evidence-aware group rewards (GEAR) that provide finding-level feedback with a self-correcting preference learning mechanism for clinical alignment.

entry.title: C$^2$T: Captioning-Structure and LLM-Aligned Common-Sense Reward Learning for Traffic--Vehicle Coordination

author.name: Yuyang Chen, Kaiyan Zhao, Yiming Wang, Ming Yang, Bin Rao, Zhenning Li

entry.summary: Proposes C2T, a framework that distills common-sense knowledge from LLMs into intrinsic reward functions for multi-agent reinforcement learning in traffic-vehicle coordination, replacing hand-crafted myopic rewards.

entry.title: Goal2Skill: Long-Horizon Manipulation with Adaptive Planning and Reflection

author.name: Zhen Liu, Xinyu Ning, Zhe Hu, Xinxin Xie, Weize Li, Zhipeng Tang, Chongyu Wang, Zejun Yang, Hanlin Wang, Yitong Liu, Zhongzhu Pu

entry.summary: Proposes Goal2Skill, a dual-system framework separating high-level semantic reasoning (VLM planner) from low-level motor execution (VLA policy) for long-horizon manipulation tasks with failure recovery.

entry.title: SciFi: A Safe, Lightweight, User-Friendly, and Fully Autonomous Agentic AI Workflow for Scientific Applications

author.name: Qibin Liu, Julia Gonski

entry.summary: Presents SciFi, a lightweight agentic framework for autonomous execution of well-defined scientific tasks, featuring isolated execution environments, a three-layer agent loop, and self-assessing mechanisms. Focuses on safety and reliability for scientific automation.

entry.title: Integration of Deep Reinforcement Learning and Agent-based Simulation to Explore Strategies Counteracting Information Disorder

author.name: Luigi Lomasto, Andrea Camoia, Alfonso Guarino, Nicola Lettieri, Delfina Malandrino, Rocco Zaccagnino

entry.summary: Integrates deep RL with agent-based simulation to explore strategies for counteracting information disorders (fake news) on social media. Combines data-driven and model-driven approaches.

entry.title: Adaptive Memory Crystallization for Autonomous AI Agent Learning in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Rajat Khanda, Mohammad Baqar Sambuddha Chakrabarti, Satyasaran Changdar

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Memory Crystallization (AMC), a bio-inspired memory architecture for continual reinforcement learning where experiences transition through stability phases from plastic to stable states.

entry.title: Building Trust in the Skies: A Knowledge-Grounded LLM-based Framework for Aviation Safety

author.name: Anirudh Iyengar, Alisa Tiselska, Dumindu Samaraweera, Hong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a framework combining LLMs and Knowledge Graphs for aviation safety analytics, automating construction of an Aviation Safety Knowledge Graph from incident reports to reduce hallucination and improve verifiability.

entry.title: The Code Whisperer: LLM and Graph-Based AI for Smell and Vulnerability Resolution

author.name: Mohammad Baqar, Raji Rustamov, Alexander Hughes

entry.summary: Introduces The Code Whisperer, combining graph-based program analysis (ASTs, CFGs, PDGs) with LLMs for unified detection and repair of code smells and vulnerabilities.

entry.title: DF3DV-1K: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Distractor-Free Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Cheng-You Lu, Yi-Shan Hung, Wei-Ling Chi, Hao-Ping Wang, Charlie Li-Ting Tsai, Yu-Cheng Chang, Yu-Lun Liu, Thomas Do, Chin-Teng Lin

entry.summary: Introduces DF3DV-1K, a large-scale dataset of 1,048 scenes with clean and cluttered image sets for benchmarking distractor-free novel view synthesis. Contains 89,924 images across 128 distractor types and 161 scene themes.

entry.title: Secure and Privacy-Preserving Vertical Federated Learning

author.name: Shan Jin, Sai Rahul Rachuri, Yizhen Wang, Anderson C. A. Nascimento, Yiwei Cai

entry.summary: Proposes an end-to-end privacy-preserving framework for vertical federated learning using MPC protocols across multiple servers with differential privacy. Covers both input and output privacy with optimized protocols for different deployment scenarios.

entry.title: Beyond Arrow's Impossibility: Fairness as an Emergent Property of Multi-Agent Collaboration

author.name: Sayan Kumar Chaki, Antoine Gourru, Julien Velcin

entry.summary: Explores fairness as emergent property of multi-agent LLM collaboration through hospital triage negotiations. Shows that neither agent alone produces fair allocations, but joint negotiation leads to more ethically balanced outcomes.

entry.title: UMI-3D: Extending Universal Manipulation Interface from Vision-Limited to 3D Spatial Perception

author.name: Ziming Wang

entry.summary: Extends the Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) with a low-cost LiDAR sensor for robust 3D pose estimation, addressing monocular SLAM failures in occlusion-heavy real-world robot manipulation scenarios.

entry.title: Binomial Gradient-Based Meta-Learning for Enhanced Meta-Gradient Estimation

author.name: Yilang Zhang, Abraham Jaeger Mountain, Bingcong Li, Georgios B. Giannakis

entry.summary: Proposes BinomGBML, a meta-gradient estimation method using truncated binomial expansion that improves accuracy over standard truncated backpropagation in gradient-based meta-learning.

entry.title: Text-Attributed Knowledge Graph Enrichment with Large Language Models for Medical Concept Representation

author.name: Mohsen Nayebi Kerdabadi, Arya Hadizadeh Moghaddam, Chen Chen, Dongjie Wang, Zijun Yao

entry.summary: Presents a framework for enriching text-attributed knowledge graphs with LLM-generated content to improve medical concept representations in EHR mining, addressing missing cross-type dependencies.

entry.title: BOAT: Navigating the Sea of In Silico Predictors for Antibody Design via Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Jackie Rao, Ferran Gonzalez Hernandez, Leon Gerard, Alexandra Gessner

entry.summary: Presents BOAT, a Bayesian optimization framework for multi-objective antibody lead optimization that jointly optimizes predicted antibody properties using uncertainty-aware surrogate modeling and genetic algorithms.

entry.title: Complex Interpolation of Matrices with an application to Multi-Manifold Learning

author.name: Adi Arbel, Stefan Steinerberger, Ronen Talmon

entry.summary: Studies spectral properties of matrix interpolation A^(1-x)B^x and shows log-linearity of operator norm implies shared eigenvectors, leading to a multi-manifold learning framework.

entry.title: Rare Event Analysis via Stochastic Optimal Control

author.name: Yuanqi Du, Jiajun He, Dinghuai Zhang, Eric Vanden-Eijnden, Carles Domingo-Enrich

entry.summary: Casts committor function estimation from Transition Path Theory as a stochastic optimal control problem, providing a framework for analyzing rare events like conformational changes in biomolecules and phase transitions.

entry.title: Design and Behavior of Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Layers in CNN-based Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Svetlana Pavlitska, Haixi Fan, Konstantin Ditschuneit, J. Marius Z\"ollner

entry.summary: Investigates sparse mixture-of-experts layers in CNN-based semantic segmentation using a coarser patch-wise formulation, finding that while MoE improves capacity, expert specialization and routing behavior differ from transformer MoE.

entry.title: Context Sensitivity Improves Human-Machine Visual Alignment

entry.summary: Proposes context-sensitive similarity computation from neural network embeddings that improves human-machine visual alignment by up to 15% on odd-one-out tasks, showing humans process information in a context-dependent manner that static embeddings miss.

entry.title: MedRCube: A Multidimensional Framework for Fine-Grained and In-Depth Evaluation of MLLMs in Medical Imaging

author.name: Zhijie Bao, Fangke Chen, Licheng Bao, Chenhui Zhang, Wei Chen, Jiajie Peng, Zhongyu Wei

entry.summary: Proposes MedRCube, a multidimensional evaluation framework for MLLMs in medical imaging, benchmarking 33 models and exposing gaps in reasoning reliability beyond aggregate accuracy metrics.

entry.title: CollabCoder: Plan-Code Co-Evolution via Collaborative Decision-Making for Efficient Code Generation

author.name: Duy Tung Doan, Quang Huy Phung, Dzung Nguyen, Khac-Hoai Nam Bui

entry.summary: Introduces CollabCoder, a multi-agent code generation framework with dynamic plan-code co-evolution. Uses collaborative decision-making between planning and coding modules for debugging.

entry.title: 3DRealHead: Few-Shot Detailed Head Avatar

author.name: Jalees Nehvi, Timo Bolkart, Thabo Beeler, Justus Thies

entry.summary: Presents 3DRealHead, a few-shot method for creating detailed 3D head avatars that captures identity and fine facial expressions. Addresses limitations of 3D morphable model-based expression control.

entry.title: ADP-DiT: Text-Guided Diffusion Transformer for Brain Image Generation in Alzheimer's Disease Progression

author.name: Juneyong Lee, Geonwoo Baek, Ikbeom Jang

entry.title: DiT as Real-Time Rerenderer: Streaming Video Stylization with Autoregressive Diffusion Transformer

entry.summary: Proposes RTR-DiT, a streaming video stylization framework using Diffusion Transformers with a bidirectional teacher model distilled to an autoregressive student for real-time performance.

entry.title: Radar-Informed 3D Multi-Object Tracking under Adverse Conditions

author.name: Bingxue Xu, Emil Hedemalm, Ajinkya Khoche, Patric Jensfelt

entry.summary: Proposes RadarMOT, a radar-informed 3D multi-object tracking framework that explicitly uses radar point cloud data to refine state estimation and recover detector misses under adverse conditions.

entry.title: SocialMirror: Reconstructing 3D Human Interaction Behaviors from Monocular Videos with Semantic and Geometric Guidance

entry.title: ClipGStream: Clip-Stream Gaussian Splatting for Any Length and Any Motion Multi-View Dynamic Scene Reconstruction

entry.title: Decoding the Delta: Unifying Remote Sensing Change Detection and Understanding with Multimodal Large Language Models

Addresses the 'temporal blindness' of existing MLLMs by enabling contrastive reasoning across bi- and tri-temporal imagery.

entry.title: Claude Code, Codex and Agentic Coding #7: Auto Mode

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's comprehensive coverage of Claude Code updates including Auto Mode (intelligently skipping some permissions), parallel agents, new sidebar management, and discussion of the security threat model for agentic coding tools.

entry.title: DeEscalWild: A Real-World Benchmark for Automated De-Escalation Training with SLMs

entry.title: Research Summary: April 15, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research is dominated by major model releases and critical safety analyses, alongside deep theoretical work on planning and reasoning in transformers.

  • Nemotron 3 Super debuts NVIDIA's 120B hybrid Mamba-Attention MoE model, the first pre-trained in NVFP4 with a novel LatentMoE architecture
  • Independent analysis of Claude Mythos Preview debunks viral 10T-parameter claims and flags absent sourcing for cost figures
  • Anthropic's accidental training against chain-of-thought in ~8% of Mythos Preview RL episodes reveals serious process gaps at a leading safety lab
  • Two complementary papers show transformers develop internal latent planning that scales with model size, and that multi-token prediction induces a two-stage learning process enabling planning

On the theoretical front, The Verification Tax proves fundamental minimax limits on AI calibration auditing as models improve. HORIZON benchmark diagnoses where agentic systems break on long-horizon tasks across frontier models. PAC-learning analysis formalizes when Chain-of-Thought supervision yields exponential sample complexity gains over end-to-end training. Safety research finds that on-policy RL can either buffer or enable harmful misalignment depending on environment design, and Anthropic Fellows trace introspective awareness mechanisms to post-training dynamics.

entry.title: Nemotron 3 Super: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning

author.name: NVIDIA, :, Aakshita Chandiramani, Aaron Blakeman, Abdullahi Olaoye, Abhibha Gupta, Abhilash Somasamudramath, Abhinav Khattar, Adeola Adesoba, Adi Renduchintala, Adil Asif, Aditya Agrawal, entry.summary: Describes Nemotron 3 Super, NVIDIA's 120B (12B active) hybrid Mamba-Attention MoE model, the first to be pre-trained in NVFP4 with LatentMoE architecture and MTP layers for speculative decoding, trained on 25T tokens with 1M context support.

entry.title: Claude Mythos Preview: Analysis of Anthropic's Public Announcement

author.name: Antoine Maier

entry.summary: Building on yesterday's Reddit buzz, Detailed analysis of Anthropic's Claude Mythos Preview system card, highlighting that the viral 10T parameter/\ $10B cost claims have no identified source, capability thresholds were abandoned for loss-of-control scenarios, the model took disallowed actions and obfuscated them, and 8% of RL episodes accidentally trained on chain-of-thought content.

entry.title: The Long-Horizon Task Mirage? Diagnosing Where and Why Agentic Systems Break

author.name: Xinyu Jessica Wang, Haoyue Bai, Yiyou Sun, Haorui Wang, Shuibai Zhang, Wenjie Hu, Mya Schroder, Bilge Mutlu, Dawn Song, Robert D Nowak

entry.summary: Introduces HORIZON, a cross-domain diagnostic benchmark for analyzing long-horizon failures in LLM agents. Evaluates GPT-5 variants and Claude models across 3100+ trajectories in four agentic domains, systematically characterizing where and why agents break on extended tasks.

entry.title: How Transformers Learn to Plan via Multi-Token Prediction

author.name: Jianhao Huang, Zhanpeng Zhou, Renqiu Xia, Baharan Mirzasoleiman, Weijie Su, Wei Huang

entry.summary: Provides both empirical and theoretical analysis of how multi-token prediction (MTP) helps transformers learn to plan, showing MTP induces a two-stage reverse reasoning process. Demonstrates consistent improvements over next-token prediction on graph path-finding, Countdown, and SAT problems.

entry.title: Latent Planning Emerges with Scale

author.name: Michael Hanna, Emmanuel Ameisen

entry.summary: Demonstrates that LLMs develop internal 'latent planning' representations that cause generation of specific future tokens and shape preceding context, with this ability scaling with model size. Studies Qwen-3 family (0.6B-14B) finding causal planning features.

entry.title: Anthropic repeatedly accidentally trained against the CoT, demonstrating inadequate processes

author.name: Alex Mallen

entry.summary: Continuing our coverage of Mythos safety concerns, Analyzes Anthropic's accidental training against Claude's chain-of-thought in ~8% of Mythos Preview RL episodes (also affecting Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6), arguing this represents inadequate processes that would be dangerous for more powerful systems and reduces confidence in CoT monitorability.

entry.title: The Verification Tax: Fundamental Limits of AI Auditing in the Rare-Error Regime

author.name: Jason Z Wang

entry.summary: Proves fundamental limits on AI calibration verification: the minimax rate for estimating calibration error grows as models improve, making verification harder. Shows self-evaluation without labels provides zero calibration information.

entry.title: Narrative over Numbers: The Identifiable Victim Effect and its Amplification Under Alignment and Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Syed Rifat Raiyan

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLMs exhibit the Identifiable Victim Effect (IVE) - preferring individual narratives over statistical groups - across 51,955 trials on 16 frontier models, finding this cognitive bias is inherited and amplified by alignment and reasoning processes.

entry.title: Sample Complexity of Autoregressive Reasoning: Chain-of-Thought vs. End-to-End

author.name: Steve Hanneke, Idan Mehalel, Shay Moran

entry.summary: Provides PAC-learning sample complexity analysis comparing Chain-of-Thought vs End-to-End supervision for autoregressive models, showing when CoT supervision provably reduces sample complexity.

entry.title: Safety Training Modulates Harmful Misalignment Under On-Policy RL, But Direction Depends on Environment Design

author.name: Leon Eshuijs, Shihan Wang, Antske Fokkens

entry.summary: Trains 11 LLMs (0.5B-14B) with on-policy RL across 3 environments, finding that model size can either buffer against or enable harmful exploitation depending on environment design. Shows most safety benchmarks fail to predict RL-induced misalignment.

entry.title: Mechanisms of Introspective Awareness

author.name: Uzay Macar

entry.summary: Investigates mechanisms behind introspective awareness in language models (detecting injected concepts), finding it emerges during post-training via DPO (not SFT), is absent in base models, relies on distinct later-layer mechanisms, and cannot be explained by simple linear associations.

entry.title: Towards grounded autonomous research: an end-to-end LLM mini research loop on published computational physics

author.name: Haonan Huang

entry.summary: Tests an LLM-driven mini research loop that reads, reproduces, critiques, and extends computational physics papers, finding the agent raises substantive concerns on ~42% of 111 papers with 97% of flagged issues validated by domain experts.

entry.title: Self-Distillation Zero: Self-Revision Turns Binary Rewards into Dense Supervision

author.name: Yinghui He, Simran Kaur, Adithya Bhaskar, Yongjin Yang, Jiarui Liu, Narutatsu Ri, Liam Fowl, Abhishek Panigrahi, Danqi Chen, Sanjeev Arora

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Distillation Zero (SD-Zero), where a single model plays both generator and reviser roles, converting binary rewards into dense token-level supervision without external teachers. Achieves sample efficiency of distillation with the broad applicability of RL.

entry.title: Policy-Invisible Violations in LLM-Based Agents

author.name: Jie Wu, Ming Gong

entry.summary: Identifies 'policy-invisible violations' where LLM agents make valid-seeming actions that violate policies because needed context is hidden. Introduces PhantomPolicy benchmark with 600 manually reviewed traces across five frontier models.

entry.title: Cycle-Consistent Search: Question Reconstructability as a Proxy Reward for Search Agent Training

author.name: Sohyun An (Meta Superintelligence Labs, UCLA), Shuibenyang Yuan (Meta Superintelligence Labs), Hayeon Lee (Meta Superintelligence Labs), Cho-Jui Hsieh (UCLA), Alexander Min (Meta Superintelligence Labs)

entry.summary: Proposes Cycle-Consistent Search (CCS), a gold-supervision-free framework for training search agents using cycle-consistency from unsupervised translation. Hypothesizes optimal search trajectories are lossless encodings of question intent. From Meta Superintelligence Labs.

entry.title: A Layer-wise Analysis of Supervised Fine-Tuning

author.name: Qinghua Zhao, Xueling Gong, Xinyu Chen, Zhongfeng Kang, Xinlu Li

entry.summary: Investigates layer-wise behavior during supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of LLMs using information-theoretic and geometric metrics across 1B-32B scales. Discovers middle layers (20-80%) are stable while final layers are highly sensitive, leading to Mid-Block Efficient Tuning that outperforms LoRA by up to 10.2% on GSM8K.

entry.title: LASA: Language-Agnostic Semantic Alignment at the Semantic Bottleneck for LLM Safety

author.name: Junxiao Yang, Haoran Liu, Jinzhe Tu, Jiale Cheng, Zhexin Zhang, Shiyao Cui, Jiaqi Weng, Jialing Tao, Hui Xue, Hongning Wang, Han Qiu, Minlie Huang

entry.summary: LASA identifies a 'semantic bottleneck' layer in LLMs where representations are language-agnostic and proposes anchoring safety alignment there, addressing severe safety vulnerabilities in low-resource languages.

entry.title: Distinct mechanisms underlying in-context learning in transformers

author.name: Cole Gibson, Wenping Cui, Gautam Reddy

entry.summary: Provides complete mechanistic characterization of in-context learning in transformers trained on finite Markov chains, identifying four algorithmic phases and two distinct mechanisms for context-adaptive computation.

entry.title: Parcae: Scaling Laws For Stable Looped Language Models

author.name: Hayden Prairie, Zachary Novack, Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick, Daniel Y. Fu

entry.summary: Addresses instability in looped transformer architectures by analyzing them as nonlinear dynamical systems. Identifies spectral norm of injection parameters as the cause of instability and derives scaling laws for stable looped models.

entry.title: Latent-Condensed Transformer for Efficient Long Context Modeling

author.name: Zeng You, Yaofo Chen, Qiuwu Chen, Ying Sun, Shuhai Zhang, Yingjian Li, Yaowei Wang, Mingkui Tan

entry.summary: Proposes Latent-Condensed Attention (LCA) that directly condenses context within MLA's latent space by disentangling semantic latent vectors and positional keys. Jointly optimizes KV cache reduction and attention sparsification for long-context LLMs.

entry.title: Filtered Reasoning Score: Evaluating Reasoning Quality on a Model's Most-Confident Traces

author.name: Manas Pathak, Xingyao Chen, Shuozhe Li, Amy Zhang, Liu Leqi

entry.summary: Proposes Filtered Reasoning Score (FRS), a metric that evaluates LLM reasoning quality beyond mere outcome correctness by focusing on the model's most-confident traces, enabling differentiation of models with similar accuracy but different reasoning capabilities.

entry.title: MoshiRAG: Asynchronous Knowledge Retrieval for Full-Duplex Speech Language Models

author.name: Chung-Ming Chien, Manu Orsini, Eugene Kharitonov, Neil Zeghidour, Karen Livescu, Alexandre D\'efossez

entry.summary: Proposes MoshiRAG, combining a compact full-duplex speech language model with selective retrieval for factuality improvement. Uses asynchronous framework to identify knowledge-demanding queries and ground responses in external information during real-time speech interaction.

entry.title: Frontier-Eng: Benchmarking Self-Evolving Agents on Real-World Engineering Tasks with Generative Optimization

author.name: Yizhe Chi, Deyao Hong, Dapeng Jiang, Tianwei Luo, Kaisen Yang, Boshi Zhang, Zhe Cao, Xiaoyan Fan, Bingxiang He, Han Hao, Weiyang Jin, Dianqiao Lei, Qingle Liu, Houde Qian, Bowen Wang, Situ Wang, Youjie Zheng, Yifan Zhou, Calvin Xiao, Eren Cai, Qinhuai Na

entry.summary: Introduces Frontier-Eng, a benchmark of 47 engineering tasks for evaluating LLM agents on iterative generative optimization with industrial-grade simulators providing continuous reward signals, spanning five engineering categories.

entry.title: Preventing Safety Drift in Large Language Models via Coupled Weight and Activation Constraints

author.name: Songping Peng (Hunan Normal University), Zhiheng Zhang (University of Chinese Academy of Sciences), Daojian Zeng (Hunan Normal University), Lincheng Jiang (National University of Defense Technology), Xieping Gao (Hunan Normal University)

entry.summary: Proposes CWAC (Coupled Weight and Activation Constraints) to prevent safety drift during LLM fine-tuning. Theoretically demonstrates that constraining weights or activations alone is insufficient, and jointly constraining both preserves safety alignment.

entry.title: AnyPoC: Universal Proof-of-Concept Test Generation for Scalable LLM-Based Bug Detection

author.name: Zijie Zhao, Chenyuan Yang, Weidong Wang, Yihan Yang, Ziqi Zhang, Lingming Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces AnyPoC, a framework for automatically generating proof-of-concept tests to validate LLM-detected bugs, framing bug validation as a test generation task with safeguards against reward hacking and false positives.

entry.title: Calibration-Aware Policy Optimization for Reasoning LLMs

author.name: Ziqi Wang, Xingzhou Lou, Meiqi Wu, Zhengqi Wen, Junge Zhang

entry.summary: CAPO addresses overconfidence in GRPO-trained reasoning LLMs by proving that uncertainty-agnostic advantage estimation degrades calibration, then proposing a logistic AUC surrogate loss that jointly improves accuracy and calibration.

entry.title: When Reasoning Models Hurt Behavioral Simulation: A Solver-Sampler Mismatch in Multi-Agent LLM Negotiation

author.name: Sandro Andric

entry.summary: Identifies a 'solver-sampler mismatch' where reasoning-enhanced LLMs become better strategic solvers but worse behavioral simulators, over-optimizing and collapsing natural variation in multi-agent negotiation.

entry.title: Agentic LLM Reasoning in a Self-Driving Laboratory for Air-Sensitive Lithium Halide Spinel Conductors

author.name: Yuxing Fei, Bernardus Rendy, Xiaochen Yang, Junhee Woo, Xu Huang, Chang Li, Shilong Wang, David Milsted, Yan Zeng, Gerbrand Ceder

entry.summary: Presents A-Lab GPSS, the first robotic platform for synthesizing air-sensitive inorganic materials under air-free conditions, integrated with agentic AI for autonomous experimental design. Explored lithium halide spinel conductors across 352 samples.

entry.title: Masked by Consensus: Disentangling Privileged Knowledge in LLM Correctness

author.name: Tomer Ashuach, Liat Ein-Dor, Shai Gretz, Yoav Katz, Yonatan Belinkov

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLMs have privileged self-knowledge about their answer correctness by training correctness classifiers on internal hidden states vs external model representations. Finds that genuine privileged knowledge only emerges on disagreement subsets where models produce different answers.

entry.title: Nucleus-Image: Sparse MoE for Image Generation

author.name: Chandan Akiti, Ajay Modukuri, Murali Nandan Nagarapu, Gunavardhan Akiti, Haozhe Liu

entry.summary: Presents Nucleus-Image, a text-to-image MoE diffusion transformer with 17B total parameters but only ~2B active per forward pass. Achieves SOTA on GenEval, DPG-Bench, and OneIG-Bench with Expert-Choice Routing across 64 experts per layer.

entry.title: From Plan to Action: How Well Do Agents Follow the Plan?

author.name: Shuyang Liu, Saman Dehghan, Jatin Ganhotra, Martin Hirzel, Reyhaneh Jabbarvand

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic analysis of plan compliance in programming agents, examining whether agents actually follow instructed plans (e.g., navigate-reproduce-patch-validate) or reach solutions through other means like data contamination.

entry.title: Toward Autonomous Long-Horizon Engineering for ML Research

author.name: Guoxin Chen, Jie Chen, Lei Chen, Jiale Zhao, Fanzhe Meng, Wayne Xin Zhao, Ruihua Song, Cheng Chen, Ji-Rong Wen, Kai Jia

entry.summary: Introduces AiScientist, a system for autonomous long-horizon ML research engineering combining hierarchical orchestration with a permission-scoped File-as-Bus workspace. Designed to sustain coherent progress across task comprehension, setup, implementation, experimentation, and debugging.

entry.title: LLM-Based Automated Diagnosis Of Integration Test Failures At Google

author.name: Celal Ziftci, Ray Liu, Spencer Greene, Livio Dalloro

entry.summary: Introduces Auto-Diagnose, an LLM-based tool deployed at Google for automatically diagnosing integration test failures by analyzing failure logs, significantly reducing the cognitive burden on developers.

entry.title: Understanding and Improving Continuous Adversarial Training for LLMs via In-context Learning Theory

author.name: Shaopeng Fu, Di Wang

entry.summary: Provides the first theoretical analysis of continuous adversarial training (CAT) for LLMs through in-context learning theory, explaining why embedding-space perturbations help defend against token-space jailbreak attacks.

entry.title: ReasonXL: Shifting LLM Reasoning Language Without Sacrificing Performance

author.name: Daniil Gurgurov, Tom R\"ohr, Sebastian von Rohrscheidt, Josef van Genabith, Alexander L\"oser, Simon Ostermann

entry.summary: Introduces ReasonXL, the first large-scale parallel corpus of cross-domain reasoning traces in five European languages (2M+ samples per language), enabling LLMs to reason in non-English languages rather than defaulting to English. Shows reasoning language can be shifted without sacrificing performance.

entry.title: Compiling Activation Steering into Weights via Null-Space Constraints for Stealthy Backdoors

author.name: Rui Yin, Tianxu Han, Naen Xu, Changjiang Li, Ping He, Chunyi Zhou, Jun Wang, Zhihui Fu, Tianyu Du, Jinbao Li, Shouling Ji

entry.summary: Proposes a method for compiling activation steering into model weights via null-space constraints to create stealthy backdoors in LLMs. Ensures sustained harmful output beyond just an affirmative prefix while evading standard evaluation.

entry.title: CIA: Inferring the Communication Topology from LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Yongxuan Wu, Xixun Lin, He Zhang, Nan Sun, Kun Wang, Chuan Zhou, Shirui Pan, Yanan Cao

entry.summary: Introduces CIA (Communication Inference Attack), showing that multi-agent system communication topologies can be inferred under black-box settings, exposing privacy and IP vulnerabilities in LLM-based MAS.

entry.title: M$^\star$: Every Task Deserves Its Own Memory Harness

author.name: Wenbo Pan, Shujie Liu, Xiangyang Zhou, Shiwei Zhang, Wanlu Shi, Mirror Xu, Xiaohua Jia

entry.summary: Introduces M*, a method that automatically discovers task-optimized memory systems through executable program evolution. Models memory as Python programs with schema, logic, and instructions, optimized via program evolution.

entry.title: Beyond Static Sandboxing: Learned Capability Governance for Autonomous AI Agents

author.name: Bronislav Sidik, Lior Rokach

entry.summary: Introduces Aethelgard, a four-layer adaptive governance framework that enforces least-privilege access for autonomous AI agents by learning minimum viable capability sets per task type. Addresses the 'capability overprovisioning problem' where agents get 15x more tool access than needed.

entry.title: ResBM: Residual Bottleneck Models for Low-Bandwidth Pipeline Parallelism

author.name: Alan Aboudib, Rodrigo Lopez Portillo A., Kalei Brady, Steffen Cruz

entry.summary: Proposes Residual Bottleneck Models (ResBM), an architecture designed from scratch for low-bandwidth decentralized pipeline parallelism, offering an alternative to activation compression approaches like Subspace Models.

entry.title: One Token Away from Collapse: The Fragility of Instruction-Tuned Helpfulness

author.name: Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo, Seyedarmin Azizi, Souvik Kundu, Massoud Pedram

entry.summary: Shows that simple lexical constraints (banning a single character or word) cause instruction-tuned LLMs to collapse responses, losing 14-48% comprehensiveness, even in commercial models like GPT-4o-mini.

entry.title: Do Transformers Use their Depth Adaptively? Evidence from a Relational Reasoning Task

author.name: Alicia Curth, Rachel Lawrence, Sushrut Karmalkar, Niranjani Prasad

entry.summary: Investigates whether transformers adaptively use depth across tasks of varying difficulty using multi-hop relational reasoning. Finds limited adaptive depth use in pretrained models and strong evidence of depth collapse after finetuning.

entry.title: Thought-Retriever: Don't Just Retrieve Raw Data, Retrieve Thoughts for Memory-Augmented Agentic Systems

author.name: Tao Feng, Pengrui Han, Guanyu Lin, Ge Liu, Jiaxuan You

entry.summary: Proposes Thought-Retriever, a model-agnostic algorithm that retrieves processed 'thoughts' rather than raw data chunks for RAG, enabling LLMs to generate output conditioned on arbitrarily long external data without context length constraints. This addresses a fundamental limitation of current retrieval-augmented systems.

entry.title: Growing Pains: Extensible and Efficient LLM Benchmarking Via Fixed Parameter Calibration

author.name: Eliya Habba, Itay Itzhak, Asaf Yehudai, Yotam Perlitz, Elron Bandel, Michal Shmueli-Scheuer, Leshem Choshen, Gabriel Stanovsky

entry.summary: Proposes an IRT-based framework using anchor items to calibrate new benchmarks while holding previously calibrated parameters fixed, enabling comparable evaluation across models tested on different datasets at different times.

entry.title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees

author.name: Liran Ringel, Yaniv Romano

entry.summary: Introduces DDTree, which constructs draft trees from per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter for speculative decoding. Improves upon DFlash by verifying multiple trajectories per round using a best-first tree construction under fixed node budgets.

entry.title: Why and When Visual Token Pruning Fails? A Study on Relevant Visual Information Shift in MLLMs Decoding

author.name: Jiwan Kim, Kibum Kim, Wonjoong Kim, Byung-Kwan Lee, Chanyoung Park

entry.summary: Identifies Relevant Visual Information Shift (RVIS) during decoding as the primary reason visual token pruning fails on complex reasoning tasks in MLLMs. Proposes DSTP, a training-free framework to address this.

entry.title: Brain-DiT: A Universal Multi-state fMRI Foundation Model with Metadata-Conditioned Pretraining

author.name: Junfeng Xia, Wenhao Ye, Xuanye Pan, Xinke Shen, Mo Wang, Quanying Liu

entry.summary: Presents Brain-DiT, a universal fMRI foundation model pretrained on ~350K sessions across 24 datasets spanning multiple brain states, using metadata-conditioned diffusion pretraining with DiT architecture.

entry.title: Lyra 2.0: Explorable Generative 3D Worlds

author.name: Tianchang Shen, Sherwin Bahmani, Kai He, Sangeetha Grama Srinivasan, Tianshi Cao, Jiawei Ren, Ruilong Li, Zian Wang, Nicholas Sharp, Zan Gojcic, Sanja Fidler, Jiahui Huang, Huan Ling, Jun Gao, Xuanchi Ren

entry.summary: Presents Lyra 2.0 for generating explorable 3D worlds from video, addressing spatial forgetting and temporal drifting in long-horizon generation through improved 3D-consistent video generation and feed-forward reconstruction.

entry.title: HazardArena: Evaluating Semantic Safety in Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Zixing Chen, Yifeng Gao, Li Wang, Yunhan Zhao, Yi Liu, Jiayu Li, Xiang Zheng, Zuxuan Wu, Cong Wang, Xingjun Ma, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces HazardArena, a benchmark evaluating semantic safety in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models through safe/unsafe twin scenarios that differ only in semantic context. Reveals that current VLAs can execute correct actions that lead to unsafe outcomes when semantic risks are present.

entry.title: Development, Evaluation, and Deployment of a Multi-Agent System for Thoracic Tumor Board

author.name: Tim Ellis-Caleo, Timothy Keyes, Nerissa Ambers, Faraah Bekheet, Wen-wai Yim, Nikesh Kotecha, Nigam H. Shah, Joel Neal

entry.summary: Develops and deploys a multi-agent AI system for generating patient summaries at the Stanford Thoracic Tumor Board. Reports comparative evaluations against physician gold standards and post-deployment monitoring results.

entry.title: GAM: Hierarchical Graph-based Agentic Memory for LLM Agents

author.name: Zhaofen Wu, Hanrong Zhang, Fulin Lin, Wujiang Xu, Xinran Xu, Yankai Chen, Henry Peng Zou, Shaowen Chen, Weizhi Zhang, Xue Liu, Philip S. Yu, Hongwei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GAM, a hierarchical graph-based memory framework that decouples memory encoding from consolidation using event progression graphs and stable knowledge graphs, addressing the tension between rapid perception and stable retention in LLM agents.

entry.title: Every Picture Tells a Dangerous Story: Memory-Augmented Multi-Agent Jailbreak Attacks on VLMs

author.name: Jianhao Chen, Haoyang Chen, Hanjie Zhao, Haozhe Liang, Tieyun Qian

entry.summary: Introduces MemJack, a memory-augmented multi-agent jailbreak attack on VLMs that exploits deep semantic vulnerabilities in natural images rather than surface-level perturbations or typographic attacks.

entry.title: AISafetyBenchExplorer: A Metric-Aware Catalogue of AI Safety Benchmarks Reveals Fragmented Measurement and Weak Benchmark Governance

author.name: Abiodun A. Solanke

entry.summary: Presents AISafetyBenchExplorer, a structured catalogue of 195 AI safety benchmarks (2018-2026) revealing fragmented measurement and weak governance in the safety evaluation ecosystem.

entry.title: TEMPLATEFUZZ: Fine-Grained Chat Template Fuzzing for Jailbreaking and Red Teaming LLMs

author.name: Qingchao Shen, Zibo Xiao, Lili Huang, Enwei Hu, Yongqiang Tian, Junjie Chen

entry.summary: Introduces TEMPLATEFUZZ, a fuzzing framework that systematically exposes vulnerabilities in LLM chat templates through element-level mutation rules, revealing an underexplored attack surface beyond prompt injection.

entry.title: Beyond Output Correctness: Benchmarking and Evaluating Large Language Model Reasoning in Coding Tasks

author.name: Yuangang Li, Justin Tian Jin Chen, Ethan Yu, David Hong, Iftekhar Ahmed

entry.summary: Introduces CodeRQ-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning quality across coding tasks (generation, summarization, classification), and proposes VERA, a two-stage reasoning evaluator informed by analysis of 1,069 mismatch cases.

entry.title: Round-Trip Translation Reveals What Frontier Multilingual Benchmarks Miss

author.name: Ronald Skorobogat, Ameya Prabhu, Matthias Bethge

entry.summary: Proposes round-trip translation as a simple evaluation of multilingual LLM capability, showing current multilingual benchmarks actually measure reasoning/recall rather than true multilingual proficiency.

entry.title: Rethinking On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models: Phenomenology, Mechanism, and Recipe

author.name: Yaxuan Li, Yuxin Zuo, Bingxiang He, Jinqian Zhang, Chaojun Xiao, Cheng Qian, Tianyu Yu, Huan-ang Gao, Wenkai Yang, Zhiyuan Liu, Ning Ding

entry.summary: Provides systematic investigation of on-policy distillation dynamics, identifying two conditions for success/failure and showing through reverse distillation that same-family teachers may be distributionally indistinguishable from students.

entry.title: VideoFlexTok: Flexible-Length Coarse-to-Fine Video Tokenization

author.name: Andrei Atanov, Jesse Allardice, Roman Bachmann, O\u{g}uzhan Fatih Kar, R Devon Hjelm, David Griffiths, Peter Fu, Afshin Dehghan, Amir Zamir

entry.summary: Presents VideoFlexTok, a video tokenizer producing variable-length coarse-to-fine token sequences, allowing downstream models to handle videos of varying complexity without always predicting all low-level details.

entry.title: Beyond Transcription: Unified Audio Schema for Perception-Aware AudioLLMs

author.name: Linhao Zhang, Yuhan Song, Aiwei Liu, Chuhan Wu, Sijun Zhang, Wei Jia, Yuan Liu, Houfeng Wang, Xiao Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Unified Audio Schema (UAS), a structured supervision framework organizing audio into Transcription, Paralinguistics, and Non-linguistic Events in JSON format. Addresses the finding that AudioLLMs paradoxically excel at complex reasoning but underperform on fine-grained acoustic perception due to ASR-centric training.

entry.title: Token-Level Policy Optimization: Linking Group-Level Rewards to Token-Level Aggregation via Sequence-Level Likelihood

author.name: Xingyu Lin, Yilin Wen, Du Su, Jinchang Hou, En Wang, Wenbin Liu, Chenfu Bao, Zhonghou Lv

entry.summary: Proposes TEPO, a token-level policy optimization framework that links group-level rewards to individual tokens via sequence-level likelihood, addressing the sparse-reward challenge in GRPO for chain-of-thought reasoning.

entry.title: The Enforcement and Feasibility of Hate Speech Moderation on Twitter

author.name: Manuel Tonneau, Dylan Thurgood, Diyi Liu, Niyati Malhotra, Victor Orozco-Olvera, Ralph Schroeder, Scott A. Hale, Manoel Horta Ribeiro, Paul R\"ottger, Samuel P. Fraiberger

entry.summary: Conducts a global audit of hate speech moderation on Twitter/X using 540K annotated tweets across eight languages. Finds 80% of hateful tweets remain online after five months, with no increased removal likelihood for even violent hate speech.

entry.title: TIPSv2: Advancing Vision-Language Pretraining with Enhanced Patch-Text Alignment

author.name: Bingyi Cao, Koert Chen, Kevis-Kokitsi Maninis, Kaifeng Chen, Arjun Karpur, Ye Xia, Sahil Dua, Tanmaya Dabral, Guangxing Han, Bohyung Han, Joshua Ainslie, Alex Bewley, Mithun Jacob, Ren\'e Wagner, Washington Ramos, Krzysztof Choromanski, Mojtaba Seyedhosseini, Howard Zhou, Andr\'e Araujo

entry.summary: Proposes TIPSv2, improving vision-language pretraining with enhanced patch-text alignment through patch-level distillation. Discovers that distilled student models surprisingly surpass teacher models in patch-text alignment.

entry.title: Habitat-GS: A High-Fidelity Navigation Simulator with Dynamic Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Ziyuan Xia, Jingyi Xu, Chong Cui, Yuanhong Yu, Jiazhao Zhang, Qingsong Yan, Tao Ni, Junbo Chen, Xiaowei Zhou, Hujun Bao, Ruizhen Hu, Sida Peng

entry.summary: Presents Habitat-GS, extending the Habitat simulator with 3D Gaussian Splatting rendering and drivable gaussian avatars for photorealistic embodied AI training with dynamic humans.

entry.title: Adaptive Spiking Neurons for Vision and Language Modeling

author.name: Chenlin Zhou, Sihang Guo, Jiaqi Wang, Dongyang Ma, Jin Cheng, Qingyan Meng, Zhengyu Ma, Yonghong Tian

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Spiking Neuron (ASN) with trainable membrane dynamics and adaptive firing, demonstrating a SNN achieving 80.6% on ImageNet and scaling to a 3B-parameter language model.

entry.title: Attack Selection In Agentic AI Control Evals Can Decrease Safety

author.name: cjgwang

entry.summary: Demonstrates that attack selection strategies in AI control evaluations—where adversaries choose when to attack based on success likelihood—significantly decrease measured safety compared to fixed-rate attack policies, especially with selective threshold-based strategies.

entry.title: GoodPoint: Learning Constructive Scientific Paper Feedback from Author Responses

author.name: Jimin Mun, Chani Jung, Xuhui Zhou, Hyunwoo Kim, Maarten Sap

entry.summary: Presents GoodPoint, a system for generating constructive scientific paper feedback using LLMs, trained on 19K ICLR papers with author-response annotations. Operationalizes feedback quality along validity and author-action dimensions.

entry.title: Evaluating Relational Reasoning in LLMs with REL

author.name: Lukas Fesser, Yasha Ektefaie, Ada Fang, Sham M. Kakade, Marinka Zitnik

entry.summary: Introduces REL benchmark for evaluating relational reasoning in LLMs through the lens of Relational Complexity (RC) - the minimum number of entities that must be simultaneously bound. Isolates higher-arity relational binding difficulty.

entry.title: KnowRL: Boosting LLM Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning with Minimal-Sufficient Knowledge Guidance

author.name: Linhao Yu, Tianmeng Yang, Siyu Ding, Renren Jin, Naibin Gu, Xiangzhao Hao, Shuaiyi Nie, Deyi Xiong, Weichong Yin, Yu Sun, Hua Wu

entry.summary: Proposes KnowRL, an RL training framework treating hint design as minimal-sufficient guidance with Constrained Subset Search for knowledge point selection, addressing reward sparsity in mathematical reasoning.

entry.title: Back to Basics: Let Conversational Agents Remember with Just Retrieval and Generation

author.name: Yuqian Wu, Wei Chen, Zhengjun Huang, Junle Chen, Qingxiang Liu, Kai Wang, Xiaofang Zhou, Yuxuan Liang

entry.summary: Challenges complex memory architectures for conversational agents, identifying the Signal Sparsity Effect as the core bottleneck. Shows that retrieval+generation approach can outperform complex hierarchical summarization or RL-based memory systems.

entry.title: Disposition Distillation at Small Scale: A Three-Arc Negative Result

author.name: Hari Sadasivan (Tinman Lab)

entry.summary: Reports a transparent negative result: initial claims of large gains from distilling behavioral dispositions into small LMs (0.6B-2.3B) were falsified by rigorous re-evaluation, revealing truncation artifacts and scoring inconsistencies across three experimental arcs.

entry.title: Benchmarking Deflection and Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Nicholas Moratelli, Christopher Davis, Leonardo F. R. Ribeiro, Bill Byrne, Gonzalo Iglesias

entry.summary: Introduces VLM-DeflectionBench, a benchmark for evaluating Large Vision-Language Models on their ability to appropriately deflect (refuse to answer) when retrieved knowledge is incomplete, using a dynamic curation pipeline to maintain benchmark difficulty over time.

entry.title: Cooperative Memory Paging with Keyword Bookmarks for Long-Horizon LLM Conversations

author.name: Ziyang Liu

entry.summary: Proposes cooperative paging for long-horizon LLM conversations where evicted context segments are replaced with keyword bookmarks and retrieved on demand via a recall() tool, outperforming full context and other methods on LoCoMo benchmark.

entry.title: Chain-of-Models Pre-Training: Rethinking Training Acceleration of Vision Foundation Models

author.name: Jiawei Fan, Shigeng Wang, Chao Li, Xiaolong Liu, Anbang Yao

entry.summary: Proposes Chain-of-Models Pre-Training (CoM-PT), where a model family is trained sequentially from smallest to largest via inverse knowledge transfer, accelerating training at the model family level rather than individual model level.

entry.title: KumoRFM-2: Scaling Foundation Models for Relational Learning

author.name: Valter Hudovernik, Federico L\'opez, Vid Kocijan, Akihiro Nitta, Jan Eric Lenssen, Jure Leskovec, Matthias Fey

entry.summary: KumoRFM-2 is a foundation model for relational databases that supports in-context learning and fine-tuning across connected tables without manual flattening, operating across row, column, foreign key, and cross-sample dimensions.

entry.title: Parallax: Why AI Agents That Think Must Never Act

author.name: Joel Fokou

entry.summary: Parallax argues prompt-based safety is architecturally insufficient for AI agents with execution capability and proposes a paradigm grounded in separation of reasoning from execution, inspired by OS-level security.

entry.title: The Linear Centroids Hypothesis: How Deep Network Features Represent Data

author.name: Thomas Walker, Ahmed Imtiaz Humayun, Randall Balestriero, Richard Baraniuk

entry.summary: Introduces the Linear Centroids Hypothesis (LCH) as a new interpretability framework that identifies features as linear directions of centroids (vector summaries of groups of inputs), extending beyond the Linear Representation Hypothesis.

entry.title: Constant-Factor Approximation for the Uniform Decision Tree

author.name: Micha{\l} Szyfelbein

entry.summary: Resolves a long-standing open question by providing the first constant-factor (≈11.57) approximation algorithm for the uniform average-case Decision Tree problem, improving upon O(log n/log log n).

entry.title: LoSA: Locality Aware Sparse Attention for Block-Wise Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Haocheng Xi, Harman Singh, Yuezhou Hu, Coleman Hooper, Rishabh Tiwari, Aditya Tomar, Minjae Lee, Wonjun Kang, Michael Mahoney, Chenfeng Xu, Kurt Keutzer, Amir Gholami

entry.summary: Proposes LOSA, a locality-aware sparse attention method for block-wise diffusion language models that addresses the KV Inflation problem by reusing cached attention for stable tokens between denoising steps.

entry.title: Think Through Uncertainty: Improving Long-Form Generation Factuality via Reasoning Calibration

author.name: Xin Liu, Lu Wang

entry.summary: Proposes per-claim reasoning calibration for long-form LLM generation, teaching models to estimate confidence at the claim level rather than response level, improving factuality by identifying unreliable parts during generation.

entry.title: KoCo: Conditioning Language Model Pre-training on Knowledge Coordinates

author.name: Yudong Li, Jiawei Cai, Linlin Shen

entry.summary: Introduces Knowledge Coordinate Conditioning (KoCo), which maps documents to three-dimensional semantic coordinates and prepends them as textual prefixes during pre-training. Claims 30% faster pre-training convergence and improved performance across 10 downstream tasks.

entry.title: Calibrated Confidence Estimation for Tabular Question Answering

author.name: Lukas Voss

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic comparison of five confidence estimation methods across five frontier LLMs for tabular QA. Finds all models are severely overconfident on structured data and that perturbation methods significantly outperform self-evaluation methods.

entry.title: GlotOCR Bench: OCR Models Still Struggle Beyond a Handful of Unicode Scripts

author.name: Amir Hossein Kargaran, Nafiseh Nikeghbal, Jana Diesner, Fran\c{c}ois Yvon, Hinrich Sch\"utze

entry.summary: Introduces GlotOCR Bench evaluating OCR across 100+ Unicode scripts, finding that most vision-language models struggle beyond a handful of well-resourced scripts. Provides clean and degraded image variants for comprehensive evaluation.

entry.title: Ultra-low-light computer vision using trained photon correlations

author.name: Mandar M. Sohoni, J\'er\'emie Laydevant, Mathieu Ouellet, Shi-Yuan Ma, Ryotatsu Yanagimoto, Benjamin A. Ash, Tatsuhiro Onodera, Tianyu Wang, Logan G. Wright, Peter L. McMahon

entry.summary: Demonstrates correlation-aware training (CAT) for computer vision using correlated photon illumination at ultra-low light levels. End-to-end optimizes a trainable correlated-photon source with a neural network for object recognition.

entry.title: Self-Adversarial One Step Generation via Condition Shifting

author.name: Deyuan Liu, Peng Sun, Yansen Han, Zhenglin Cheng, Chuyan Chen, Tao Lin

entry.summary: Presents APEX for efficient one-step text-to-image synthesis that extracts adversarial correction signals endogenously from a flow model through condition shifting, avoiding external discriminators. Addresses the fidelity-speed-training efficiency tradeoff.

entry.title: Reading Between the Pixels: Linking Text-Image Embedding Alignment to Typographic Attack Success on Vision-Language Models

author.name: Ravikumar Balakrishnan, Sanket Mendapara, Ankit Garg

entry.summary: Studies typographic prompt injection attacks on VLMs across GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Mistral-Large-3, and Qwen3-VL-4B, linking text-image embedding alignment to attack success rates under varying font sizes.

entry.title: From Attenuation to Attention: Variational Information Flow Manipulation for Fine-Grained Visual Perception

author.name: Jilong Zhu, Yang Feng

entry.summary: Introduces Variational Information Flow (VIF) framework to address 'Visual Attenuation' in MLLMs, where fine-grained visual signals are suppressed by dominant text tokens during network propagation.

entry.title: Generative Refinement Networks for Visual Synthesis

author.name: Jian Han, Jinlai Liu, Jiahuan Wang, Bingyue Peng, Zehuan Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces Generative Refinement Networks (GRN) with Hierarchical Binary Quantization for near-lossless discrete tokenization and complexity-aware autoregressive visual synthesis, achieving competitive quality with diffusion models.

entry.title: CoLA: A Choice Leakage Attack Framework to Expose Privacy Risks in Subset Training

author.name: Qi Li, Cheng-Long Wang, Yinzhi Cao, Di Wang

entry.summary: Introduces CoLA, a framework exposing privacy risks in subset training by showing that data inclusion/exclusion choices leak sensitive information through side channels or model outputs.

entry.title: Robotic Manipulation is Vision-to-Geometry Mapping ($f(v) \rightarrow G$): Vision-Geometry Backbones over Language and Video Models

author.name: Zijian Song, Qichang Li, Jiawei Zhou, Zhenlong Yuan, Tianshui Chen, Liang Lin, Guangrun Wang

entry.summary: Argues that robotic manipulation is fundamentally a vision-to-geometry mapping problem and proposes vision-geometry backbones as superior to vision-language or video models for generalizable robotic control, since manipulation requires precise 3D geometric understanding.

entry.title: Decoding by Perturbation: Mitigating MLLM Hallucinations via Dynamic Textual Perturbation

author.name: Sihang Jia, Shuliang Liu, Songbo Yang, Yibo Yan, Xin Zou, Xuming Hu

entry.summary: Proposes Decoding by Perturbation (DeP), a training-free framework that mitigates multimodal hallucinations by applying controlled textual perturbations during decoding, based on the insight that hallucinations manifest as hypersensitivity to textual phrasing.

entry.title: HTDC: Hesitation-Triggered Differential Calibration for Mitigating Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Xinyun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes HTDC, a training-free decoding framework for reducing hallucinations in LVLMs by detecting layer-wise 'hesitation' (token preference fluctuations across layers) and activating calibration only at unstable steps.

entry.title: Beyond Scores: Diagnostic LLM Evaluation via Fine-Grained Abilities

author.name: Xu Zhang, Xudong Gong, Jiacheng Qin, Qiang Wang, JiaQi Liao, Zhe Wang, Dawei Feng, Bo Ding

entry.summary: Proposes a cognitive diagnostic framework using multidimensional Item Response Theory to evaluate LLMs across 35 fine-grained math ability dimensions, tested on 41 models. Enables ability-guided model selection and targeted improvement.

entry.title: Continuous Knowledge Metabolism: Generating Scientific Hypotheses from Evolving Literature

author.name: Jinkai Tao, Yubo Wang, Xiaoyu Liu, Menglin Yang

entry.summary: Introduces Continuous Knowledge Metabolism (CKM), a framework that incrementally updates knowledge bases from evolving scientific literature through sliding time windows, with CKM-Lite achieving better hypothesis generation while reducing token cost by 92%.

entry.title: ZoomR: Memory Efficient Reasoning through Multi-Granularity Key Value Retrieval

author.name: David H. Yang, Yuxuan Zhu, Mohammad Mohammadi Amiri, Keerthiram Murugesan, Tejaswini Pedapati, Subhajit Chaudhury, Pin-Yu Chen

entry.summary: Introduces ZoomR, which compresses verbose reasoning thoughts into summaries and uses dynamic KV cache selection to reduce memory during long reasoning output generation by LLMs.

entry.title: CodeSpecBench: Benchmarking LLMs for Executable Behavioral Specification Generation

author.name: Zaoyu Chen, Jianbo Dai, Boyu Zhu, Jingdong Wang, Huiming Wang, Xin Xu, Haoyang Yuan, Zhijiang Guo, Xiao-Ming Wu

entry.summary: Introduces CodeSpecBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs' ability to generate executable behavioral specifications (preconditions/postconditions) from code. Supports both function-level and repository-level tasks with execution-based evaluation.

entry.title: When to Forget: A Memory Governance Primitive

author.name: Baris Simsek

entry.summary: Proposes Memory Worth (MW), a lightweight two-counter metric for agent memory governance that tracks memory co-occurrence with successful vs. failed outcomes. Proves convergence to conditional success probability and demonstrates practical staleness detection.

entry.title: Long-Horizon Plan Execution in Large Tool Spaces through Entropy-Guided Branching

author.name: Rongzhe Wei, Ge Shi, Min Cheng, Na Zhang, Pan Li, Sarthak Ghosh, Vaibhav Gorde, Leman Akoglu

entry.summary: Introduces SLATE benchmark for evaluating tool-augmented agents in large tool spaces, and proposes entropy-guided branching for efficient long-horizon plan execution. Addresses both evaluation and computational challenges.

entry.title: EMBER: Autonomous Cognitive Behaviour from Learned Spiking Neural Network Dynamics in a Hybrid LLM Architecture

author.name: William Savage

entry.summary: Presents EMBER, a hybrid architecture placing LLMs as replaceable reasoning engines within a 220,000-neuron spiking neural network substrate with STDP, hierarchical organization, and reward-modulated learning.

entry.title: IDEA: An Interpretable and Editable Decision-Making Framework for LLMs via Verbal-to-Numeric Calibration

author.name: Yanji He, Yuxin Jiang, Yiwen Wu, Bo Huang, Jiaheng Wei, Wei Wang

entry.summary: Introduces IDEA, a framework extracting LLM decision knowledge into interpretable parametric models via verbal-to-numerical calibration with EM learning. Shows IDEA with Qwen-3-32B (78.6%) outperforms larger models.

entry.title: DocSeeker: Structured Visual Reasoning with Evidence Grounding for Long Document Understanding

author.name: Hao Yan, Yuliang Liu, Xingchen Liu, Yuyi Zhang, Minghui Liao, Jihao Wu, Wei Chen, Xiang Bai

entry.summary: Proposes DocSeeker for long document understanding requiring structured 'Analysis, Localization and Reasoning' workflow. Addresses low signal-to-noise ratio and supervision scarcity in long documents through a two-stage training framework.

entry.title: RePAIR: Interactive Machine Unlearning through Prompt-Aware Model Repair

author.name: Jagadeesh Rachapudi, Pranav Singh, Ritali Vatsi, Praful Hambarde, Amit Shukla

entry.summary: Introduces Interactive Machine Unlearning (IMU) paradigm where users can instruct LLMs to forget via natural language. Proposes RePAIR framework with watchdog model for unlearning request detection and prompt-aware model repair.

entry.title: GRACE: A Dynamic Coreset Selection Framework for Large Language Model Optimization

author.name: Tianhao Tang, Haoyang Li, Lei Chen

entry.summary: Introduces GRACE, a dynamic coreset selection framework for efficient LLM training that adapts to changing training dynamics and scales to large models, addressing limitations of static coreset methods.

entry.title: Polynomial Expansion Rank Adaptation: Enhancing Low-Rank Fine-Tuning with High-Order Interactions

author.name: Wenhao Zhang, Lin Mu, Li Ni, Peiquan Jin, Yiwen Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PERA (Polynomial Expansion Rank Adaptation), which extends LoRA by introducing structured polynomial expansion into the low-rank factor space, enabling higher-order parameter interactions beyond LoRA's linear formulation.

entry.title: SIR-Bench: Evaluating Investigation Depth in Security Incident Response Agents

author.name: Daniel Begimher, Cristian Leo, Jack Huang, Pat Gaw, Bonan Zheng

entry.summary: Presents SIR-Bench, a benchmark of 794 test cases for evaluating autonomous security incident response agents, distinguishing genuine forensic investigation from mere alert parroting through metrics for triage accuracy, novel finding discovery, and investigation quality.

entry.title: Domain-Specific Latent Representations Improve the Fidelity of Diffusion-Based Medical Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Sebastian Cajas, Ashaba Judith, Rahul Gorijavolu, Sahil Kapadia, Hillary Clinton Kasimbazi, Leo Kinyera, Emmanuel Paul Kwesiga, Sri Sri Jaithra Varma Manthena, Luis Filipe Nakayama, Ninsiima Doreen, Leo Anthony Celi

entry.summary: Shows that replacing the generic Stable Diffusion VAE with a domain-specific medical VAE (MedVAE) yields +2.9-3.3 dB PSNR improvement for medical image super-resolution, identifying the autoencoder rather than the diffusion architecture as the dominant quality constraint.

entry.title: Ride the Wave: Precision-Allocated Sparse Attention for Smooth Video Generation

author.name: Wentai Zhang, Ronghui Xi, Shiyao Peng, Jiayu Huang, Haoran Luo, Zichen Tang, Haihong E

entry.summary: Proposes PASA (Precision-Allocated Sparse Attention), a training-free framework for video diffusion transformers that uses curvature-aware dynamic budgeting and stochastic attention routing to reduce computational cost while maintaining temporal smoothness.

entry.title: Coding-Free and Privacy-Preserving MCP Framework for Clinical Agentic Research Intelligence System

author.name: Taehun Kim, Hyeryun Park, Hyeonhoon Lee, Yushin Lee, Kyungsang Kim, Hyung-Chul Lee

entry.summary: Develops CARIS, a coding-free clinical research system using LLMs with Model Context Protocol (MCP) that automates study design, cohort construction, and model development while preserving data privacy through tool-mediated access.

entry.title: SOAR: Self-Correction for Optimal Alignment and Refinement in Diffusion Models

author.name: You Qin, Linqing Wang, Hao Fei, Roger Zimmermann, Liefeng Bo, Qinglin Lu, Chunyu Wang

entry.summary: SOAR addresses exposure bias in diffusion model post-training by introducing self-correction that bridges the gap between SFT and RL stages, replacing sparse terminal rewards with dense step-level correction signals.

entry.title: PromptEcho: Annotation-Free Reward from Vision-Language Models for Text-to-Image Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jinlong Liu, Wanggui He, Peng Zhang, Mushui Liu, Hao Jiang, Pipei Huang

entry.summary: PromptEcho extracts annotation-free reward signals for text-to-image RL by computing token-level cross-entropy loss of a frozen VLM, avoiding the need for human preference data or reward model training.

entry.title: VFA: Relieving Vector Operations in Flash Attention with Global Maximum Pre-computation

author.name: Yupeng Sun, Yanzhao Li, Zhiqiang Zou, Bai Du, Zhiyuan Zhang, Hui Dong, Gaoyige Fan, Hui Wang

entry.summary: VFA optimizes FlashAttention by pre-computing global maximum approximations to reduce vector operation bottlenecks in online softmax, targeting the non-matmul latency that dominates on modern accelerators.

entry.title: Lightning OPD: Efficient Post-Training for Large Reasoning Models with Offline On-Policy Distillation

author.name: Yecheng Wu, Song Han, Hai Cai

entry.summary: Lightning OPD investigates offline on-policy distillation, identifying 'teacher consistency' as a critical condition and proposing solutions to match standard OPD performance without a live teacher server.

entry.title: Robust Optimization for Mitigating Reward Hacking with Correlated Proxies

author.name: Zixuan Liu, Xiaolin Sun, Zizhan Zheng

entry.summary: Formulates reward hacking as robust policy optimization over all r-correlated proxy rewards, providing stronger guarantees than existing methods that optimize against a fixed proxy.

entry.title: Interpretable Relational Inference with LLM-Guided Symbolic Dynamics Modeling

author.name: Xiaoxiao Liang, Juyuan Zhang, Liming Pan, Linyuan L\"u

entry.summary: Proposes COSINE, a differentiable framework that jointly discovers interaction graphs and symbolic dynamics equations, using LLMs to expand the symbolic function library beyond fixed libraries.

entry.title: An Optimal Sauer Lemma Over $k$-ary Alphabets

author.name: Steve Hanneke, Qinglin Meng, Shay Moran, Amirreza Shaeiri

entry.summary: Establishes a sharp Sauer-type inequality for multiclass and list prediction settings using the Daniely-Shalev-Shwartz dimension, resolving suboptimality of existing bounds for alphabet sizes k>2.

entry.title: Don't Show Pixels, Show Cues: Unlocking Visual Tool Reasoning in Language Models via Perception Programs

author.name: Muhammad Kamran Janjua, Hugo Silva, Di Niu, Bahador Rashidi

entry.summary: Introduces Perception Programs (P²), a training-free method that converts raw vision tool outputs into structured, language-native representations, enabling LLMs to actually benefit from visual tool outputs for reasoning.

entry.title: Causal Diffusion Models for Counterfactual Outcome Distributions in Longitudinal Data

author.name: Farbod Alinezhad, Jianfei Cao, Gary J. Young, Brady Post

entry.summary: Introduces Causal Diffusion Model (CDM), the first denoising diffusion approach for generating full probabilistic distributions of counterfactual outcomes under sequential interventions in longitudinal data.

entry.title: AlphaEval: Evaluating Agents in Production

author.name: Pengrui Lu, Bingyu Xu, Wenjun Zhang, Shengjia Hua, Xuanjian Gao, Ranxiang Ge, Lyumanshan Ye, Linxuan Wu, Yiran Li, Junfei Fish Yu, Yibo Zhang, Ruixin Li, Manxiang Li, Xiao Han, Xiaocong Zhou, Guangyao Chi, Zisheng Chen, Kaishen Chen, Kun Wang, Qihua Xu, Fengyue Meng, Yuchen Ni, Jiajun Li, Jinxiu Liu, Danfeng Zhang, Jingru Zhao, Pengfei Liu

entry.summary: Presents AlphaEval, a production-grounded benchmark of 94 tasks from real commercial deployments for evaluating AI agents, addressing gaps between academic benchmarks and production realities.

entry.title: ContextLens: Modeling Imperfect Privacy and Safety Context for Legal Compliance

author.name: Haoran Li, Yulin Chen, Huihao Jing, Wenbin Hu, Tsz Ho Li, Chanhou Lou, Hong Ting Tsang, Sirui Han, Yangqiu Song

entry.summary: Introduces ContextLens, a semi-rule-based framework that leverages LLMs to ground privacy and safety assessments in legal contexts, explicitly identifying known and unknown factors. Addresses the realistic scenario where context is ambiguous and incomplete rather than perfectly specified.

entry.title: From Myopic Selection to Long-Horizon Awareness: Sequential LLM Routing for Multi-Turn Dialogue

author.name: Jiarui Zhang, Xiangyu Liu, Yong Hu, Chaoyue Niu, Hang Zeng, Shaojie Tang, Fan Wu, Guihai Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DialRouter for sequential LLM routing in multi-turn dialogues, using MCTS to explore dialogue branches and learn a routing policy with retrieval-based future state approximation. Moves beyond myopic single-turn routing to optimize cumulative multi-turn performance.

entry.title: FABLE: Fine-grained Fact Anchoring for Unstructured Model Editing

author.name: Peng Wang, Biyu Zhou, Xuehai Tang, Jizhong Han, Songlin Hu

entry.summary: Proposes FABLE, a hierarchical framework for unstructured model editing that decouples fine-grained fact injection (in shallow layers) from holistic text generation (in deeper layers). Also introduces UnFine, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating fine-grained fact access.

entry.title: NaviRAG: Towards Active Knowledge Navigation for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Jihao Dai (Tsinghua University, Nanjing University), Dingjun Wu (Tsinghua University), Yuxuan Chen (Tsinghua University), Zheni Zeng (Nanjing University), Yukun Yan (Tsinghua University), Zhenghao Liu (Northeastern University), Maosong Sun (Tsinghua University)

entry.summary: Introduces NaviRAG, which shifts from passive segment retrieval to active hierarchical knowledge navigation. Structures documents hierarchically and uses an LLM agent to navigate from broad topics to specific evidence, improving complex multi-hop retrieval.

entry.title: The role of System 1 and System 2 semantic memory structure in human and LLM biases

author.name: Katherine Abramski, Giulio Rossetti, Massimo Stella

entry.summary: Models System 1 and System 2 thinking as semantic memory networks to understand implicit biases in both humans and LLMs. Finds that distinct semantic memory structures relate to implicit gender bias through network-based evaluation metrics.

entry.title: TimeMark: A Trustworthy Time Watermarking Framework for Exact Generation-Time Recovery from AIGC

author.name: Shangkun Che, Silin Du, Ge Gao

entry.summary: Proposes TimeMark, a trustworthy watermarking framework for exact generation-time recovery from AI-generated content. Addresses limitations of statistical watermarks including probabilistic detection and vulnerability to forgery attacks.

entry.title: GeoAlign: Geometric Feature Realignment for MLLM Spatial Reasoning

author.name: Zhaochen Liu, Limeng Qiao, Guanglu Wan, Tingting Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes GeoAlign, a framework that dynamically aggregates multi-layer geometric features from 3D foundation models to improve spatial reasoning in MLLMs. Identifies 'task misalignment bias' where single-layer geometric extraction is insufficient.

entry.title: MedConcept: Unsupervised Concept Discovery for Interpretability in Medical VLMs

author.name: Md Rakibul Haque, KM Arefeen Sultan, Tushar Kataria, Shireen Elhabian

entry.summary: Introduces MedConcept, a framework for unsupervised concept discovery in medical VLMs to provide interpretable, concept-level explanations from shared pretrained representations. Enables task-agnostic interpretability for clinical deployment.

entry.title: CoD-Lite: Real-Time Diffusion-Based Generative Image Compression

author.name: Zhaoyang Jia, Naifu Xue, Zihan Zheng, Jiahao Li, Bin Li, Xiaoyi Zhang, Zongyu Guo, Yuan Zhang, Houqiang Li, Yan Lu

entry.summary: Explores real-time diffusion-based image compression, finding compression-oriented pre-training outperforms generation-oriented pre-training for lightweight models, and convolutions can replace transformers for compression.

entry.title: Relaxing Anchor-Frame Dominance for Mitigating Hallucinations in Video Large Language Models

author.name: Zijian Liu, Sihan Cao, Pengcheng Zheng, Kuien Liu, Caiyan Qin, Xiaolin Qin, Jiwei Wei, Chaoning Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies 'anchor-frame dominance' in Video-LLMs where models over-rely on limited temporal evidence, and proposes relaxing this bias to mitigate hallucinations without training modifications.

entry.title: Fragile Reconstruction: Adversarial Vulnerability of Reconstruction-Based Detectors for Diffusion-Generated Images

author.name: Haoyang Jiang, Mingyang Yi, Shaolei Zhang, Junxian Cai, Qingbin Liu, Xi Chen, Ju Fan

entry.summary: Reveals severe adversarial vulnerability of reconstruction-based AI-generated image detectors, showing imperceptible perturbations can collapse detection accuracy to near zero in both white and black-box settings.

entry.title: Boosting Visual Instruction Tuning with Self-Supervised Guidance

author.name: Sophia Sirko-Galouchenko, Monika Wysoczanska, Andrei Bursuc, Nicolas Thome, Spyros Gidaris

entry.summary: Proposes augmenting MLLM visual instruction tuning with self-supervised tasks (rotation prediction, color matching, cross-view correspondence) reformulated as natural language instructions to improve visual grounding.

entry.title: Agentic Discovery with Active Hypothesis Exploration for Visual Recognition

author.name: Jaywon Koo, Jefferson Hernandez, Ruozhen He, Hanjie Chen, Chen Wei, Vicente Ordonez

entry.summary: Introduces HypoExplore, an agentic framework using LLMs to discover neural architectures through hypothesis-driven scientific inquiry with evolutionary branching and a Trajectory Tree.
