entry.title: Scaling Exposes the Trigger: Input-Level Backdoor Detection in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Cross-Attention Scaling

author.name: Zida Li, Jun Li, Yuzhe Sha, Ziqiang Li, Lizhi Xiong, Zhangjie Fu

entry.summary: Proposes cross-attention scaling as an active probing method for detecting backdoor triggers in text-to-image diffusion models, working even against stealthy semantics-preserving trigger designs.

entry.title: Claude Mythos #3: Capabilities and Additions

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Comprehensive analysis of Claude Mythos capabilities beyond cybersecurity, discussing the model's relationship to AI 2027 predictions, White House response, and overall assessment that Mythos isn't a trend break but represents meaningful progress.

entry.title: Modality-Native Routing in Agent-to-Agent Networks: A Multimodal A2A Protocol Extension

author.name: Vasundra Srinivasan

entry.summary: Shows that modality-native routing in Agent-to-Agent networks improves accuracy by 20pp over text-bottleneck baselines, but only when paired with capable reasoning agents. Introduces MMA2A architecture for multimodal A2A routing.

entry.title: VISTA: Validation-Informed Trajectory Adaptation via Self-Distillation

author.name: Eli Corn, Daphna Weinshall

entry.summary: Introduces VISTA, an online self-distillation framework that addresses 'Trajectory Deviation' - where models abandon high-generalization states during training. Uses validation-informed marginal coverage to identify expert anchors from earlier training states.

entry.title: Local-Splitter: A Measurement Study of Seven Tactics for Reducing Cloud LLM Token Usage on Coding-Agent Workloads

author.name: Justice Owusu Agyemang, Jerry John Kponyo, Elliot Amponsah, Godfred Manu Addo Boakye, Kwame Opuni-Boachie Obour Agyekum

entry.summary: Presents a systematic measurement study of seven tactics for reducing cloud LLM token usage by using small local models as triage layers, implemented in an open-source shim supporting MCP and OpenAI-compatible APIs.

entry.title: Self-Monitoring Benefits from Structural Integration: Lessons from Metacognition in Continuous-Time Multi-Timescale Agents

author.name: Ying Xie

entry.summary: Investigates whether self-monitoring modules (metacognition, self-prediction) help RL agents in continuous-time multi-timescale settings. Finds that add-on modules provide no benefit, but structurally integrating them into the agent hierarchy yields significant improvements.

entry.title: Aethon: A Reference-Based Replication Primitive for Constant-Time Instantiation of Stateful AI Agents

author.name: Swanand Rao, Kiran Kashalkar, Parvathi Somashekar, Priya Krishnan

entry.summary: Introduces Aethon, a reference-based replication primitive enabling near-constant-time instantiation of stateful AI agents through compositional views over stable definitions and layered memory, rather than full materialization.

entry.title: Beyond Prompt: Fine-grained Simulation of Cognitively Impaired Standardized Patients via Stochastic Steering

author.name: Weikang Zhang, Zimo Zhu, Zhichuan Yang, Chen Huang, Wenqiang Lei, See-Kiong Ng

entry.summary: Proposes StsPatient for fine-grained simulation of cognitively impaired patients using steering vectors and stochastic token modulation, enabling precise control over impairment severity for clinical training.

entry.title: HintMR: Eliciting Stronger Mathematical Reasoning in Small Language Models

author.name: Jawad Hossain, Xiangyu Guo, Jiawei Zhou, Chong Liu

entry.summary: Introduces HintMR, a cooperative two-model system where one SLM generates context-aware hints to guide another SLM through multi-step math reasoning via distillation from a large teacher model.

entry.title: Operationalising the Right to be Forgotten in LLMs: A Lightweight Sequential Unlearning Framework for Privacy-Aligned Deployment in Politically Sensitive Environments

author.name: Esen Kurt, Haithem Afli

entry.summary: Introduces a lightweight sequential unlearning framework for GDPR Right to be Forgotten in LLMs, separating retention and suppression objectives through positive fine-tuning followed by layer-restricted negative fine-tuning.

entry.title: Drawing on Memory: Dual-Trace Encoding Improves Cross-Session Recall in LLM Agents

author.name: Benjamin Stern, Peter Nadel

entry.summary: Introduces dual-trace memory encoding for LLM agents, pairing facts with narrative scene traces. Achieves 68.7% accuracy vs 53.5% baseline on LongMemEval-S benchmark for cross-session recall.

entry.title: Schema-Adaptive Tabular Representation Learning with LLMs for Generalizable Multimodal Clinical Reasoning

author.name: Hongxi Mao, Wei Zhou, Mengting Jia, Tao Fang, Huan Gao, Bin Zhang, Shangyang Li

entry.summary: Proposes Schema-Adaptive Tabular Representation Learning that uses LLMs to create transferable embeddings for clinical EHR data by converting structured variables into natural language statements. This enables zero-shot alignment across unseen schemas without retraining, addressing a key challenge in clinical ML where schemas vary widely.

entry.title: Can AI Detect Life? Lessons from Artificial Life

author.name: Ankit Gupta (Michigan State University), Christoph Adami (Michigan State University)

entry.summary: Demonstrates using Artificial Life simulations that ML methods proposed for detecting extraterrestrial life can be easily fooled by out-of-distribution samples, yielding near 100% false-positive confidence on non-living samples.

entry.title: OpenTME: An Open Dataset of AI-powered H&E Tumor Microenvironment Profiles from TCGA

author.name: Maaike Galama, Nina Kozar-Gillan, Christina Embacher, Todd Dembo, Cornelius B\"ohm, Evelyn Ramberger, Julika Ribbat-Idel, Rosemarie Krupar, Verena Aumiller, Miriam H\"agele, Kai Standvoss, Gerrit Erdmann, Blanca Pablos, Ari Angelo, Simon Schallenberg, Andrew Norgan, Viktor Matyas, Klaus-Robert M\"uller, Maximilian Alber, Lukas Ruff, Frederick Klauschen

entry.summary: Releases OpenTME, an open-access dataset of AI-computed tumor microenvironment profiles from 3,634 H&E whole-slide images across five cancer types from TCGA, generated using pathology foundation models.

entry.title: SpecBound: Adaptive Bounded Self-Speculation with Layer-wise Confidence Calibration

author.name: Zhuofan Wen, Yang Feng

entry.summary: Proposes SpecBound, a self-draft speculative decoding framework with layer-wise temperature annealing to suppress overconfident early-exit predictions and adaptive speculation length bounding based on token difficulty.

entry.title: Is Vibe Coding the Future? An Empirical Assessment of LLM Generated Codes for Construction Safety

author.name: S M Jamil Uddin

entry.summary: Empirically evaluates 450 'vibe-coded' Python scripts generated by three LLMs for construction safety calculations, finding critical risks of 'silent failures' where code compiles but executes flawed safety logic.

entry.title: MODIX: A Training-Free Multimodal Information-Driven Positional Index Scaling for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Ruoxiang Huang, Zhen Yuan

entry.summary: MODIX dynamically adapts positional index strides in vision-language models based on information density across modalities, treating positional granularity as an implicit resource. Training-free framework.

entry.title: OSC: Hardware Efficient W4A4 Quantization via Outlier Separation in Channel Dimension

author.name: Zhiyuan Zhang, Yanzhao Li, Zhiqiang Zou, Bai Du, Yupeng Sun, Hui Dong, Hui Wang

entry.summary: OSC identifies token-persistent structural clustering of activation outliers in fixed channels and proposes a dual-path W4A4 quantization framework separating outlier channels into a high-precision path.

entry.title: Towards Long-horizon Agentic Multimodal Search

author.name: Yifan Du, Zikang Liu, Jinbiao Peng, Jie Wu, Junyi Li, Jinyang Li, Wayne Xin Zhao, Ji-Rong Wen

entry.summary: LMM-Searcher introduces a file-based visual representation mechanism for long-horizon multimodal search agents, offloading visual assets to external file systems to mitigate context explosion while preserving multimodal information.

entry.title: Fast and principled equation discovery from chaos to climate

author.name: Yuzheng Zhang, Weizhen Li, Rui Carvalho

entry.summary: Bayesian-ARGOS combines rapid frequentist screening with focused Bayesian inference for automated equation discovery from noisy data, tested on seven chaotic systems including real-world climate dynamics.

entry.title: SubFlow: Sub-mode Conditioned Flow Matching for Diverse One-Step Generation

author.name: Yexiong Lin, Jia Shi, Shanshan Ye, Wanyu Wang, Yu Yao, Tongliang Liu

entry.summary: SubFlow addresses diversity degradation in few-step flow matching by identifying averaging distortion from MSE objectives and proposing sub-mode conditioned flow matching that eliminates this bias.

entry.title: Models Know Their Shortcuts: Deployment-Time Shortcut Mitigation

author.name: Jiayi Li, Shijie Tang, G\"un Kaynar, Shiyi Du, Carl Kingsford

entry.summary: Proposes Shortcut Guardrail, a deployment-time framework that mitigates token-level shortcuts in pretrained language models without needing original training data or shortcut annotations. Uses gradient-based attribution to identify shortcut tokens and trains a lightweight LoRA debiasing module with Masked Contrastive Learning.

entry.title: ProbeLogits: Kernel-Level LLM Inference Primitives for AI-Native Operating Systems

author.name: Daeyeon Son

entry.summary: Presents ProbeLogits, a kernel-level operation that performs a single LLM forward pass to classify agent actions as safe or dangerous by reading specific token logits, requiring zero learned parameters.

entry.title: On the continuum limit of t-SNE for data visualization

author.name: Jeff Calder, Zhonggan Huang, Ryan Murray, Adam Pickarski

entry.summary: Proves the continuum limit of t-SNE, showing that the KL divergence objective is consistent as n→∞ in applicable parameter regimes, providing theoretical foundations for the widely-used visualization method.

entry.title: Beyond Perception Errors: Semantic Fixation in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Md Tanvirul Alam

entry.summary: Identifies 'semantic fixation' in VLMs—the tendency to preserve default interpretations even when prompts specify alternative valid mappings. Introduces VLM-Fix benchmark using strategy games to measure this bias across 14 models.

entry.title: Beyond Majority Voting: Efficient Best-Of-N with Radial Consensus Score

author.name: Manh Nguyen, Sunil Gupta, Hung Le

entry.summary: Introduces Radial Consensus Score (RCS), a training-free method for best-of-N selection in LLM outputs that uses geometric consensus via a weighted Fréchet mean rather than simple majority voting. It leverages the geometric structure of answer representations to better identify high-quality but less frequent responses.

entry.title: Meet Dynamic Individual Preferences: Resolving Conflicting Human Value with Paired Fine-Tuning

author.name: Shanyong Wang, Shuhang Lin, Yining Zhao, Xi Zhu, Yongfeng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Preference-Paired Fine-Tuning (PFT) framework for aligning LLMs with contradictory and evolving individual preferences, along with Value Conflict Dilemma (VCD) dataset. Achieves 96.6% accuracy in multi-choice classification for preference alignment.

entry.title: UniMark: Unified Adaptive Multi-bit Watermarking for Autoregressive Image Generators

author.name: Yigit Yilmaz, Elena Petrova, Mehmet Kaya, Lucia Rossi, Amir Rahman

entry.summary: Proposes UniMark, a training-free multi-bit watermarking framework for autoregressive image generators that uses adaptive codebook partitioning. Addresses limitations of zero-bit-only watermarks and static partitioning strategies.

entry.title: PC-MIL: Decoupling Feature Resolution from Supervision Scale in Whole-Slide Learning

author.name: Syed Fahim Ahmed, Gnanesh Rasineni, Florian Koehler, Abu Zahid Bin Aziz, Mei Wang, Attila Gyulassy, Brian Summa, J. Quincy Brown, Valerio Pascucci, Shireen Y. Elhabian

entry.summary: Proposes PC-MIL for whole-slide image classification that decouples feature resolution from supervision scale, addressing the mismatch between slide-level labels and clinician-scale (millimeter) reasoning.

entry.title: ViLL-E: Video LLM Embeddings for Retrieval

author.name: Rohit Gupta, Jayakrishnan Unnikrishnan, Fan Fei, Sheng Liu, Son Tran, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Introduces ViLL-E, a unified VideoLLM architecture with a novel embedding generation mechanism for retrieval tasks. Allows model to 'think longer' for complex videos and stop early for easy ones, bridging understanding and retrieval.

entry.title: HyperLiDAR: Adaptive Post-Deployment LiDAR Segmentation via Hyperdimensional Computing

author.name: Ivannia Gomez Moreno, Yi Yao, Ye Tian, Xiaofan Yu, Flavio Ponzina, Michael Sullivan, Jingyi Zhang, Mingyu Yang, Hun Seok Kim, Tajana Rosing

entry.summary: Introduces HyperLiDAR, the first lightweight post-deployment LiDAR segmentation framework using Hyperdimensional Computing for on-device adaptation. Addresses domain shift in edge autonomous driving systems.

entry.title: DeferredSeg: A Multi-Expert Deferral Framework for Trustworthy Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Qiuyu Tian, Haoliang Sun, Yunshan Wang, Yinghuan Shi, Yilong Yin

entry.summary: Introduces DeferredSeg, a learning-to-defer framework for medical image segmentation that dynamically routes uncertain pixel predictions to human experts, addressing overconfidence issues in clinical deployment.

entry.title: Cross-Attentive Multiview Fusion of Vision-Language Embeddings

author.name: Tomas Berriel Martins, Martin R. Oswald, Javier Civera

entry.summary: Introduces a multiview transformer architecture using cross-attention to fuse vision-language descriptors from multiple viewpoints into unified 3D instance embeddings, leveraging multiview consistency as self-supervision.

entry.title: Listening Deepfake Detection: A New Perspective Beyond Speaking-Centric Forgery Analysis

author.name: Miao Liu, Fangda Wei, Jing Wang, Xinyuan Qian

entry.summary: Introduces the novel task of 'listening deepfake detection' focusing on manipulated non-speaking facial reactions, presenting a new dataset and methods for detecting synthesized listening behavior.

entry.title: OFA-Diffusion Compression: Compressing Diffusion Model in One-Shot Manner

author.name: Haoyang Jiang, Zekun Wang, Mingyang Yi, Xiuyu Li, Lanqing Hu, Junxian Cai, Qingbin Liu, Xi Chen, Ju Fan

entry.summary: Proposes OFA-Diffusion, a once-for-all compression framework for diffusion models that yields multiple subnetworks with varying computation budgets from a single training run.

entry.title: Challenging Vision-Language Models with Physically Deployable Multimodal Semantic Lighting Attacks

author.name: Yingying Zhao, Chengyin Hu, Qike Zhang, Xin Li, Xin Wang, Yiwei Wei, Jiujiang Guo, Jiahuan Long, Tingsong Jiang, Wen Yao

entry.summary: Presents physically deployable multimodal semantic lighting attacks against Vision-Language Models, moving beyond digital-only adversarial perturbations to real-world physical attacks.

entry.title: LLM-HYPER: Generative CTR Modeling for Cold-Start Ad Personalization via LLM-Based Hypernetworks

author.name: Luyi Ma, Wanjia Sherry Zhang, Zezhong Fan, Shubham Thakur, Kai Zhao, Kehui Yao, Ayush Agarwal, Rahul Iyer, Jason Cho, Jianpeng Xu, Evren Korpeoglu, Sushant Kumar, Kannan Achan

entry.summary: Proposes LLM-HYPER, using LLMs as hypernetworks to generate CTR model parameters in a training-free manner for cold-start ad personalization. Uses few-shot CoT prompting over multimodal ad content with CLIP-based retrieval of similar campaigns.

entry.title: Towards Platonic Representation for Table Reasoning: A Foundation for Permutation-Invariant Retrieval

author.name: Willy Carlos Tchuitcheu, Tan Lu, Ann Dooms

entry.summary: Argues that linearization of tables in NLP discards their geometric structure, proposes a Platonic Representation Hypothesis requiring permutation-invariant representations for table reasoning. Provides formal framework to diagnose serialization bias.

entry.title: ReflectCAP: Detailed Image Captioning with Reflective Memory

author.name: Kyungmin Min, Minbeom Kim, Kang-il Lee, Seunghyun Yoon, Kyomin Jung

entry.summary: Proposes ReflectCAP for detailed image captioning using Structured Reflection Notes that capture what models hallucinate and overlook. Evaluated on 8 LVLMs including GPT-4.1 family, Qwen, and InternVL.

entry.title: RPRA: Predicting an LLM-Judge for Efficient but Performant Inference

author.name: Dylan R. Ashley, Ga\"el Le Lan, Changsheng Zhao, Naina Dhingra, Zhipeng Cai, Ernie Chang, Mingchen Zhuge, Yangyang Shi, Vikas Chandra, J\"urgen Schmidhuber

entry.summary: Investigates RPRA paradigm where LLMs predict whether they can provide good responses before answering, deferring to larger models when they cannot. Studies viability for efficient but performant inference.

entry.title: BEAM: Bi-level Memory-adaptive Algorithmic Evolution for LLM-Powered Heuristic Design

author.name: Chuyang Xiang, Yichen Wei, Jiale Ma, Handing Wang, Junchi Yan

entry.summary: Proposes BEAM, reformulating heuristic design as bi-level optimization with LLMs evolving high-level algorithmic strategies in an exterior layer and implementation details in an interior layer, with memory-adaptive evolution.

entry.title: MVAdapt: Zero-Shot Multi-Vehicle Adaptation for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Haesung Oh, Jaeheung Park

entry.summary: Proposes MVAdapt, a physics-conditioned adaptation framework for end-to-end autonomous driving that handles the 'vehicle-domain gap' when deploying models trained on one vehicle to different vehicles with different dynamics.

entry.title: Interpretable DNA Sequence Classification via Dynamic Feature Generation in Decision Trees

author.name: Nicolas Huynh, Krzysztof Kacprzyk, Ryan Sheridan, David Bentley, Mihaela van der Schaar

entry.summary: Introduces DEFT, a framework for interpretable DNA sequence classification that adaptively generates high-level features within decision trees, overcoming the expressivity limitations of axis-aligned splits on raw sequence features.

entry.title: Characterizing Resource Sharing Practices on Underground Internet Forum Synthetic Non-Consensual Intimate Image Content Creation Communities

author.name: Bernardo B. P. Medeiros (University of Florida), Malvika Jadhav (University of Florida), Allison Lu (University of Florida), Tadayoshi Kohno (Georgetown University), Vincent Bindschaedler (University of Florida), Kevin R. B. Butler (University of Florida)

entry.summary: Characterizes resource sharing practices in underground communities creating synthetic non-consensual intimate imagery (SNCII), analyzing 282K 4chan comments and 78K Reddit submissions to map actor sophistication levels and resource flows.

entry.title: MolMem: Memory-Augmented Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Sample-Efficient Molecular Optimization

author.name: Ziqing Wang, Yibo Wen, Abhishek Pandy, Han Liu, Kaize Ding

entry.summary: Presents MolMem, a multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning framework for molecular optimization that uses long-term memory to ground decisions and provide reusable insights, improving sample efficiency under limited oracle budgets.

entry.title: Scaffold-Conditioned Preference Triplets for Controllable Molecular Optimization with Large Language Models

author.name: Yi Xiong, Liang Xiong, Xiaohong Ji, Sen Yang, Zhifeng Gao, Huaimin Wang, Kele Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Scaffold-Conditioned Preference Triplets (SCPT) for molecular optimization using LLMs with chemistry-grounded preference supervision, enabling controllable scaffold-preserving molecular edits.

entry.title: IAD-Unify: A Region-Grounded Unified Model for Industrial Anomaly Segmentation, Understanding, and Generation

author.name: Haoyu Zheng, Tianwei Lin, Wei Wang, Zhuonan Wang, Wenqiao Zhang, Jiaqi Zhu, Feifei Shao

entry.summary: Proposes IAD-Unify, a unified framework for industrial anomaly detection that jointly supports segmentation, natural language understanding, and mask-guided generation using a DINOv2-based region expert with a Qwen3.5-4B backbone, along with Anomaly-56K evaluation platform.

entry.title: Visual Preference Optimization with Rubric Rewards

author.name: Ya-Qi Yu, Fangyu Hong, Xiangyang Qu, Hao Wang, Gaojie Wu, Qiaoyu Luo, Nuo Xu, Huixin Wang, Wuheng Xu, Yongxin Liao, Zihao Chen, Haonan Li, Ziming Li, Dezhi Peng, Minghui Liao, Jihao Wu, Haoyu Ren, Dandan Tu

entry.summary: rDPO proposes rubric-based preference optimization for vision-language models, creating instance-specific checklists to score responses and guide DPO training with fine-grained visual reasoning criteria.

entry.title: Loss-Driven Bayesian Active Learning

author.name: Zhuoyue Huang, Freddie Bickford Smith, Tom Rainforth

entry.summary: Proposes loss-driven Bayesian active learning that derives unique acquisition objectives from any loss function, showing analytic computation is possible for weighted Bregman divergences.

entry.title: Monte Carlo Stochastic Depth for Uncertainty Estimation in Deep Learning

author.name: Adam T. M\"uller, Tobias R\"ogelein, Nicolaj C. Stache

entry.summary: Establishes theoretical connections between Stochastic Depth regularization and Bayesian variational inference, extending Monte Carlo uncertainty estimation beyond dropout to modern residual architectures.

entry.title: PipeLive: Efficient Live In-place Pipeline Parallelism Reconfiguration for Dynamic LLM Serving

author.name: Xu Bai, Muhammed Tawfiqul Islam, Chen Wang, Adel N. Toosi

entry.summary: Proposes PipeLive for live in-place pipeline parallelism reconfiguration during LLM serving, enabling dynamic adaptation without service interruption on platforms like vLLM.

entry.title: A Bayesian Perspective on the Role of Epistemic Uncertainty for Delayed Generalization in In-Context Learning

author.name: Abdessamed Qchohi, Simone Rossi

entry.summary: Studies grokking and task generalization in in-context learning from a Bayesian perspective, investigating how epistemic uncertainty evolves during the delayed transition from memorization to generalization in modular arithmetic tasks.

entry.title: Temporal Flattening in LLM-Generated Text: Comparing Human and LLM Writing Trajectories

author.name: Zhanwei Cao, YeoJin Go, Yifan Hu, Shanu Sushmita

entry.summary: Constructs a longitudinal dataset of 412 human authors and compares temporal writing evolution with LLM-generated trajectories, finding that LLMs exhibit 'temporal flattening'—inability to reproduce the evolution of human writing over time.

entry.title: CompliBench: Benchmarking LLM Judges for Compliance Violation Detection in Dialogue Systems

author.name: Jingbo Yang, Guanyu Yao, Bairu Hou, Xinghan Yang, Nikolai Glushnev, Iwona Bialynicka-Birula, Duo Ding, Shiyu Chang

entry.summary: Introduces CompliBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM judges' ability to detect and localize guideline violations in enterprise dialogue systems. Addresses the gap in systematic evaluation of LLM-as-a-Judge reliability for compliance monitoring.

entry.title: InsightFlow: LLM-Driven Synthesis of Patient Narratives for Mental Health into Causal Models

author.name: Shreya Gupta, Prottay Kumar Adhikary, Bhavyaa Dave, Salam Michael Singh, Aniket Deroy, Tanmoy Chakraborty

entry.summary: Presents InsightFlow, an LLM-based approach that automatically generates 5P-aligned causal graphs from psychotherapy transcripts. Expert evaluation shows generated graphs have structural similarity comparable to inter-annotator agreement.

entry.title: PolicyLLM: Towards Excellent Comprehension of Public Policy for Large Language Models

author.name: Han Bao, Penghao Zhang, Yue Huang, Zhengqing Yuan, Yanchi Ru, Rui Su, Yujun Zhou, Xiangqi Wang, Kehan Guo, Nitesh V Chawla, Yanfang Ye, Xiangliang Zhang

entry.summary: Presents PolicyBench, the first large-scale cross-system (US-China) benchmark for evaluating LLM policy comprehension with 21K cases. Assesses memorization, understanding, and application following Bloom's taxonomy.

entry.title: Adaptive Test-Time Scaling for Zero-Shot Respiratory Audio Classification

author.name: Tsai-Ning Wang, Herman Teun den Dekker, Lin-Lin Chen, Neil Zeghidour, Aaqib Saeed

entry.summary: Introduces TRIAGE, a tiered zero-shot framework for respiratory audio classification that adaptively scales test-time compute by routing samples through progressively richer reasoning stages. Easy predictions are finalized early while difficult ones use LLM reasoning.

entry.title: Boosting Robust AIGI Detection with LoRA-based Pairwise Training

author.name: Ruiyang Xia, Qi Zhang, Yaowen Xu, Zhaofan Zou, Hao Sun, Zhongjiang He, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Proposes LoRA-based Pairwise Training (LPT) for robust AI-generated image detection under severe real-world distortions. Fine-tunes a visual foundation model with deliberate distortion simulation and pairwise training.

entry.title: Towards Realistic and Consistent Orbital Video Generation via 3D Foundation Priors

author.name: Rong Wang, Ruyi Zha, Ziang Cheng, Jiayu Yang, Pulak Purkait, Hongdong Li

entry.summary: Presents a method for generating geometrically consistent orbital videos from a single image using 3D foundation model priors as auxiliary constraints. Addresses the failure of pixel-wise attention for long-range extrapolation.

entry.title: Cell Instance Segmentation via Multi-Task Image-to-Image Schr\"odinger Bridge

author.name: Hayato Inoue, Shota Harada, Shumpei Takezaki, Ryoma Bise

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-task image-to-image Schrödinger Bridge framework for cell instance segmentation, formulating it as distribution-based image-to-image generation with boundary-aware supervision.

entry.title: Bridging the Micro--Macro Gap: Frequency-Aware Semantic Alignment for Image Manipulation Localization

author.name: Xiaojie Liang, Zhimin Chen, Ziqi Sheng, Wei Lu

entry.summary: Proposes FASA for image manipulation localization that bridges micro (forensic) and macro (semantic) cues through adaptive dual-band DCT and patch-level contrastive alignment on CLIP representations. Handles both traditional and diffusion-generated manipulations.

entry.title: Combating Pattern and Content Bias: Adversarial Feature Learning for Generalized AI-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Haifeng Zhang, Qinghui He, Xiuli Bi, Bo Liu, Chi-Man Pun, Bin Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes MAFL framework using adversarial feature learning to detect AI-generated images by combating pattern and content bias that limits generalization across different generative models.

entry.title: DiffusionPrint: Learning Generative Fingerprints for Diffusion-Based Inpainting Localization

author.name: Paschalis Giakoumoglou, Symeon Papadopoulos

entry.summary: Proposes DiffusionPrint, a contrastive learning framework that learns forensic fingerprints specific to diffusion-based inpainting models for image forgery localization, robust to full-image regeneration.

entry.title: Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for PET-Free Amyloid-Beta Detection from MRI

author.name: Francesco Chiumento, Julia Dietlmeier, Ronan P. Killeen, Kathleen M. Curran, Noel E. O'Connor, Mingming Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a PET-guided knowledge distillation framework enabling amyloid-β prediction from MRI alone using BiomedCLIP-based teacher with cross-modal attention, eliminating need for PET at inference.

entry.title: Risk-Calibrated Learning: Minimizing Fatal Errors in Medical AI

author.name: Abolfazl Mohammadi-Seif, Ricardo Baeza-Yates

entry.summary: Proposes Risk-Calibrated Learning that embeds a clinical severity matrix into optimization to suppress fatal misclassification errors (e.g., malignant→benign) while preserving overall accuracy.

entry.title: Task Alignment: A simple and effective proxy for model merging in computer vision

author.name: Pau de Jorge, C\'esar Roberto de Souza, Bj\"orn Michele, Mert B\"ulent Sar{\i}y{\i}ld{\i}z, Philippe Weinzaepfel, Florent Perronnin, Diane Larlus, Yannis Kalantidis

entry.summary: Proposes task alignment as a lightweight proxy for evaluating model merging quality in computer vision, extending beyond CLIP classification to heterogeneous decoder settings.

entry.title: ReefMapGS: Enabling Large-Scale Underwater Reconstruction by Closing the Loop Between Multimodal SLAM and Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Daniel Yang, Jungseok Hong, John J. Leonard, Yogesh Girdhar

entry.summary: Proposes ReefMapGS, an incremental 3DGS-based underwater reconstruction framework that uses multimodal SLAM with acoustic/inertial/pressure sensors for camera pose estimation on field robots.

entry.title: Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation using Offline Reinforcement Learning on Sub-optimal Controllers

author.name: Snehal Jauhri, Vignesh Prasad, Georgia Chalvatzaki

entry.summary: Presents offline RL approach for whole-body mobile manipulation using sub-optimal classical controllers as data priors, showing learning can improve upon hand-tuned whole-body controllers.

entry.title: Probabilistic Feature Imputation and Uncertainty-Aware Multimodal Federated Aggregation

author.name: Nafis Fuad Shahid, Maroof Ahmed, Md Akib Haider, Saidur Rahman Sagor, Aashnan Rahman, Md Azam Hossain

entry.summary: Proposes P-FIN for multimodal federated learning that produces calibrated uncertainty estimates for imputed missing modality features, with uncertainty-aware aggregation for healthcare applications.

entry.title: Complementarity by Construction: A Lie-Group Approach to Solving Quadratic Programs with Linear Complementarity Constraints

author.name: Arun L. Bishop, Micah I. Reich, Zachary Manchester

entry.summary: Observes that complementarity constraints form a Lie group under relaxation and leverages this structure for solving linear complementarity quadratic programs in robotics contact problems.

entry.title: Learning Versatile Humanoid Manipulation with Touch Dreaming

author.name: Yaru Niu, Zhenlong Fang, Binghong Chen, Shuai Zhou, Revanth Senthilkumaran, Hao Zhang, Bingqing Chen, Chen Qiu, H. Eric Tseng, Jonathan Francis, Ding Zhao

entry.summary: Develops a humanoid loco-manipulation system combining VR teleoperation with touch sensing, introducing Humanoid Transformer with Touch Dreaming (HTD) that generates synthetic tactile data to augment limited real-world contact demonstrations.

entry.title: The A-R Behavioral Space: Execution-Level Profiling of Tool-Using Language Model Agents in Organizational Deployment

author.name: Shasha Yu, Fiona Carroll, Barry L. Bentley

entry.summary: Introduces an execution-layer behavioral profiling approach for tool-using LLM agents using a 2D Action Rate/Refusal Signal space. Evaluates models across normative regimes and autonomy configurations.

entry.title: MultiDocFusion: Hierarchical and Multimodal Chunking Pipeline for Enhanced RAG on Long Industrial Documents

author.name: Joongmin Shin, Chanjun Park, Jeongbae Park, Jaehyung Seo, Heuiseok Lim

entry.summary: Introduces MultiDocFusion, a multimodal chunking pipeline for RAG on long industrial documents combining vision-based parsing, OCR, LLM-based hierarchical structure reconstruction, and DFS-based grouping.

entry.title: Human-Centric Topic Modeling with Goal-Prompted Contrastive Learning and Optimal Transport

author.name: Rui Wang, Yi Zheng, Dongxin Wang, Haiping Huang, Yuanzhi Yao, Yuxiang Zhou, Jialin Yu, Philip Torr

entry.summary: Introduces Human-centric Topic Modeling (Human-TM) integrating user-provided goals into topic modeling via goal-prompted contrastive learning with optimal transport, producing goal-oriented topics beyond statistical coherence.

entry.title: MISID: A Multimodal Multi-turn Dataset for Complex Intent Recognition in Strategic Deception Games

author.name: Shufang Lin, Muyang Chen, Xiabing Zhou, Rongrong Zhang, Dayou Zhang, Fangxin Wang

entry.summary: Introduces MISID, a multimodal multi-turn benchmark for complex intent recognition sourced from strategic deception games, with two-tier annotation for discourse analysis and causal tracking.

entry.title: QuarkMedSearch: A Long-Horizon Deep Search Agent for Exploring Medical Intelligence

author.name: Zhichao Lin, Zhichao Liang, Gaoqiang Liu, Meng Xu, Baoyu Xiang, Jian Xu, Guanjun Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes QuarkMedSearch for Chinese medical deep search, built on Tongyi DeepResearch. Combines medical knowledge graph with real-time exploration for long-horizon medical queries with training strategies and evaluation benchmarks.

entry.title: Observing the unobserved confounding through its effects: toward randomized trial-like estimates from real-world survival data

author.name: Vasiliki Stoumpou, Dimitris Bertsimas, Samuel Singer, Georgios Antonios Margonis

entry.summary: Develops a three-step framework to address unobserved confounding in observational survival data by inferring latent prognostic factors from outcome discrepancies, enabling closer-to-RCT treatment effect estimates.

entry.title: CycloneMAE: A Scalable Multi-Task Learning Model for Global Tropical Cyclone Probabilistic Forecasting

author.name: Renlong Hang, Zihao Xu, Jiuwei Zhao, Runling Yu, Leye Cheng, Qingshan Liu

entry.summary: Presents CycloneMAE, a scalable multi-task model for tropical cyclone probabilistic forecasting that uses masked autoencoders with multi-modal data and a discrete probabilistic gridding mechanism for simultaneous deterministic and probabilistic predictions.

entry.title: Socrates Loss: Unifying Confidence Calibration and Classification by Leveraging the Unknown

author.name: Sandra G\'omez-G\'alvez, Tobias Olenyi, Gillian Dobbie, Katerina Ta\v{s}kova

entry.summary: Proposes Socrates Loss, a unified loss function that addresses the stability-performance trade-off in confidence calibration by incorporating an auxiliary unknown class to explicitly leverage uncertainty.

entry.title: CascadeDebate: Multi-Agent Deliberation for Cost-Aware LLM Cascades

author.name: Raeyoung Chang, Dongwook Kwon, Jisoo Lee, Nikhil Verma

entry.summary: Proposes CascadeDebate, which inserts multi-agent deliberation at each tier's escalation boundary in cascaded LLM systems, using confidence-based routers to activate lightweight agent ensembles only for uncertain cases.

entry.title: Mining Large Language Models for Low-Resource Language Data: Comparing Elicitation Strategies for Hausa and Fongbe

author.name: Mahounan Pericles Adjovi, Roald Eiselen, Prasenjit Mitra

entry.summary: Investigates whether strategic prompting can extract usable text data from LLMs for low-resource West African languages (Hausa, Fongbe), finding GPT-4o Mini extracts 6-41x more usable words than Gemini with language-dependent optimal strategies.

entry.title: Orthogonal Subspace Projection for Continual Machine Unlearning via SVD-Based LoRA

author.name: Yogachandran Rahulamathavan, Nasir Iqbal, Juncheng Hu, Sangarapillai Lambotharan

entry.summary: Proposes SVD-guided orthogonal subspace projection for continual machine unlearning via LoRA, constraining sequential unlearning updates to orthogonal subspaces to prevent parameter collision.

entry.title: Algorithmic Analysis of Dense Associative Memory: Finite-Size Guarantees and Adversarial Robustness

author.name: Madhava Gaikwad

entry.summary: Provides finite-size guarantees and convergence rates for Dense Associative Memory retrieval dynamics, proving geometric convergence and adversarial robustness bounds beyond the thermodynamic limit analyses.

entry.title: ROSE: An Intent-Centered Evaluation Metric for NL2SQL

author.name: Wenqi Pei, Shizheng Hou, Boyan Li, Han Chen, Zhichao Shi, Yuyu Luo

entry.summary: ROSE introduces an intent-centered evaluation metric for NL2SQL that assesses whether predicted SQL answers the question rather than matching ground-truth SQL, using an adversarial Prover-Refuter cascade.

entry.title: Subcritical Signal Propagation at Initialization in Normalization-Free Transformers

author.name: Sergey Alekseev

entry.summary: Extends signal propagation analysis to transformers with bidirectional attention, deriving APJN recurrence relations and showing how attention modifies asymptotic behavior, with pre-LayerNorm exhibiting power-law growth.

entry.title: TriFit: Trimodal Fusion with Protein Dynamics for Mutation Fitness Prediction

author.name: Seungik Cho

entry.summary: TriFit integrates protein sequence, structure, and dynamics through a Mixture-of-Experts fusion module for predicting mutation fitness effects, incorporating protein dynamics for the first time in supervised variant effect prediction.

entry.title: PubSwap: Public-Data Off-Policy Coordination for Federated RLVR

author.name: Anupam Nayak, Baris Askin, Muhammed Ustaomeroglu, Carlee Joe-Wong, Gauri Joshi

entry.summary: PubSwap proposes federated RLVR combining LoRA-based local adaptation with public-data off-policy steps to improve cross-client coordination in decentralized reasoning post-training.

entry.title: Adaptive Budget Allocation in LLM-Augmented Surveys

author.name: Zikun Ye, Jiameng Lyu, Rui Tao

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive budget allocation algorithm for LLM-augmented surveys that learns in real-time which questions are hardest for the LLM and directs more human labeling budget to those questions.

entry.title: CLAD: Efficient Log Anomaly Detection Directly on Compressed Representations

author.name: Benzhao Tang, Shiyu Yang

entry.summary: Introduces CLAD, the first deep learning framework for log anomaly detection directly on compressed byte streams, bypassing expensive decompression and parsing by exploiting patterns in compressed data.

entry.title: All in One: A Unified Synthetic Data Pipeline for Multimodal Video Understanding

author.name: Tanzila Rahman, Renjie Liao, Leonid Sigal

entry.summary: Proposes a unified synthetic data generation pipeline for multimodal video understanding that automatically produces training data with rich supervision across tasks like counting, QA, and segmentation.

entry.title: FeaXDrive: Feasibility-aware Trajectory-Centric Diffusion Planning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Baoyun Wang, Zhuoren Li, Ming Liu, Xinrui Zhang, Bo Leng, Lu Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes FeaXDrive, a trajectory-centric diffusion planning method for autonomous driving that reformulates diffusion to operate directly in trajectory space, improving physical feasibility of generated plans.

entry.title: Classical and Quantum Speedups for Non-Convex Optimization via Energy Conserving Descent

author.name: Yihang Sun, Huaijin Wang, Patrick Hayden, Jose Blanchet

entry.summary: Analyzes the Energy Conserving Descent algorithm as a global non-convex optimizer, providing the first theoretical analysis including a quantum analog. Shows quantum speedup for escaping local minima in double-well objectives.

entry.title: Knowledge Is Not Static: Order-Aware Hypergraph RAG for Language Models

author.name: Keshu Wu, Chenchen Kuai, Zihao Li, Jiwan Jiang, Shiyu Shen, Shian Wang, Chan-Wei Hu, Zhengzhong Tu, Yang Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Order-Aware Knowledge Hypergraph RAG (OKH-RAG), which treats temporal/causal order as a first-class property in knowledge representation for RAG, reformulating retrieval as sequence inference over hyperedges.

entry.title: Towards Robust Real-World Spreadsheet Understanding with Multi-Agent Multi-Format Reasoning

author.name: Houxing Ren, Mingjie Zhan, Zimu Lu, Ke Wang, Yunqiao Yang, Haotian Hou, Hongsheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes SpreadsheetAgent, a two-stage multi-agent framework for understanding real-world spreadsheets that incrementally interprets localized regions through multiple modalities including code execution. Addresses the challenge that real spreadsheets are massive and contain complex layout cues beyond plain text.

entry.title: Universal NER v2: Towards a Massively Multilingual Named Entity Recognition Benchmark

author.name: Terra Blevins, Stephen Mayhew, Marek \v{S}uppa, Hila Gonen, Shachar Mirkin, Vasile Pais, Kaja Dobrovoljc, Voula Giouli, Jun Kevin, Eugene Jang, Eungseo Kim, Jeongyeon Seo, Xenophon Gialis, Yuval Pinter

entry.summary: Presents Universal NER v2, expanding the massively multilingual NER benchmark project with standardized cross-lingual annotations using a general tagset. Now in its fourth year, building gold-standard evaluation resources across many languages.

entry.title: Teaching LLMs Human-Like Editing of Inappropriate Argumentation via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Timon Ziegenbein, Maja Stahl, Henning Wachsmuth

entry.summary: Presents a reinforcement learning approach using GRPO to teach LLMs human-like editing of arguments, producing self-contained sentence-level edit suggestions that can be independently accepted/rejected. Addresses the mismatch between LLM and human editing strategies.

entry.title: Does Visual Token Pruning Improve Calibration? An Empirical Study on Confidence in MLLMs

author.name: Kaizhen Tan

entry.summary: Studies how visual token pruning affects model calibration in MLLMs, finding that pruning doesn't simply trade reliability for efficiency. Some pruning strategies achieve lower calibration error than no pruning.

entry.title: INST-Align: Implicit Neural Alignment for Spatial Transcriptomics via Canonical Expression Fields

author.name: Bonian Han, Cong Qi, Przemyslaw Musialski, Zhi Wei

entry.summary: Presents INST-Align for spatial transcriptomics alignment that couples a coordinate-based deformation network with a shared Canonical Expression Field. Jointly handles non-rigid deformations and batch effects across slices.

entry.title: Unlocking the Potential of Grounding DINO in Videos: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for Limited-Data Spatial-Temporal Localization

author.name: Zanyi Wang, Fan Li, Dengyang Jiang, Liuzhuozheng Li, Yunhua Zhong, Guang Dai, Mengmeng Wang

entry.summary: Introduces ST-GD, a parameter-efficient framework adapting pre-trained 2D vision-language models like Grounding DINO for spatio-temporal video grounding with limited data. Addresses the expensive annotation bottleneck for STVG tasks.

entry.title: T2I-BiasBench: A Multi-Metric Framework for Auditing Demographic and Cultural Bias in Text-to-Image Models

author.name: Nihal Jaiswal, Siddhartha Arjaria, Gyanendra Chaubey, Ankush Kumar, Aditya Singh, Anchal Chaurasiya

entry.summary: Introduces T2I-BiasBench, a framework with 13 metrics for auditing demographic, omission, and cultural bias in text-to-image models, evaluating SD v1.5, BK-SDM, Koala Lightning, and Gemini 2.5 Flash.

entry.title: Hypergraph-State Collaborative Reasoning for Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Zikai Song, Junqing Yu, Yi-Ping Phoebe Chen, Wei Yang, Xinchao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a hypergraph-based collaborative reasoning framework for multi-object tracking where correlated objects mutually constrain each other's motion estimation, improving robustness under occlusion.

entry.title: A Multi-Agent Feedback System for Detecting and Describing News Events in Satellite Imagery

author.name: Madeline Anderson, Mikhail Klassen, Ash Hoover, Kerri Cahoy

entry.summary: Introduces SkyScraper, a multi-agent workflow that geocodes news articles and synthesizes captions for satellite image sequences, finding 5x more events than traditional geocoding methods.

entry.title: A Sanity Check on Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Yikun Liu, Jiangchao Yao, Weidi Xie, Yanfeng Wang

entry.summary: Provides a 'sanity check' on Composed Image Retrieval benchmarks, identifying indeterminate queries in existing benchmarks and proposing FISD with precisely controlled semantic diversity and multi-round evaluation.

entry.title: Grasp in Gaussians: Fast Monocular Reconstruction of Dynamic Hand-Object Interactions

author.name: Ayce Idil Aytekin, Xu Chen, Zhengyang Shen, Thabo Beeler, Helge Rhodin, Rishabh Dabral, Christian Theobalt

entry.summary: Presents GraG (Grasp in Gaussians), a fast method for reconstructing dynamic 3D hand-object interactions from monocular video using a Sum-of-Gaussians representation revived from classical tracking.

entry.title: Scalable Trajectory Generation for Whole-Body Mobile Manipulation

author.name: Yida Niu, Xinhai Chang, Xin Liu, Ziyuan Jiao, Yixin Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces AutoMoMa, a GPU-accelerated framework for scalable trajectory generation for whole-body mobile manipulation across diverse embodiments and environments.

entry.title: M2HRI: An LLM-Driven Multimodal Multi-Agent Framework for Personalized Human-Robot Interaction

author.name: Shaid Hasan, Breenice Lee, Sujan Sarker, Tariq Iqbal

entry.summary: Introduces M2HRI, an LLM-driven multi-agent HRI framework giving each robot distinct personality and long-term memory, validated in a 105-participant user study.

entry.title: From personas to intentions: towards a science of motivations for AI models

author.name: David Africa

entry.summary: Proposes shifting from behavioral persona descriptions to inferring motivational structure (latent drives, values, priorities) in AI models, introducing 'inverse constitution learning' to reconstruct implicit priority hierarchies from behavior and internal traces.

entry.title: Spatial Atlas: Compute-Grounded Reasoning for Spatial-Aware Research Agent Benchmarks

author.name: Arun Sharma

entry.summary: Introduces compute-grounded reasoning (CGR) for spatial-aware agents, where deterministic computation resolves answerable sub-problems before LLM generation. Instantiated as Spatial Atlas for FieldWorkArena and MLE-Bench benchmarks.

entry.title: Unveiling the Surprising Efficacy of Navigation Understanding in End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zhihua Hua, Junli Wang, Pengfei LI, Qihao Jin, Bo Zhang, Kehua Sheng, Yilun Chen, Zhongxue Gan, Wenchao Ding

entry.summary: Proposes the Sequential Navigation Guidance (SNG) framework showing that end-to-end autonomous driving systems over-rely on local scene understanding while failing to properly utilize global navigation information.

entry.title: From Imitation to Discrimination: Progressive Curriculum Learning for Robust Web Navigation

author.name: Chuang Peng, Wei Zhang, Renshuai Tao, Xinhao Zhang, Jian Yang

entry.summary: Introduces the Triton dataset (590k instances) and progressive training curriculum for robust web navigation agents, using structural-semantic hard negative mining to improve discrimination in HTML-based environments.

entry.title: Generating Effective CoT Traces for Mitigating Causal Hallucination

author.name: Yiheng Zhao, Jun Yan

entry.summary: Investigates what makes effective CoT traces for mitigating causal hallucination in small LLMs (≤1.5B) for event causality identification. Designs a pipeline for generating quality CoT traces and introduces a causal hallucination metric.

entry.title: Memory as Metabolism: A Design for Companion Knowledge Systems

author.name: Stefan Miteski

entry.summary: Proposes a companion-specific memory governance framework inspired by biological metabolism, situated within the 2026 landscape of personal wiki-style memory architectures (Karpathy, MemPalace) and production memory systems. Discusses memory lifecycle management for personal AI companions.

entry.title: Beyond Factual Grounding: The Case for Opinion-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Aditya Agrawal, Alwarappan Nakkiran, Darshan Fofadiya, Alex Karlsson, Harsha Aduri

entry.summary: Identifies and addresses factual bias in RAG systems that treat opinions as noise rather than information. Discusses risks including echo chambers and underrepresentation of minority viewpoints.

entry.title: AutoSurrogate: An LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Framework for Autonomous Construction of Deep Learning Surrogate Models in Subsurface Flow

author.name: Jiale Liu, Nanzhe Wang

entry.summary: Presents AutoSurrogate, an LLM-driven multi-agent framework that automates the construction of deep learning surrogate models for subsurface flow simulation, enabling domain scientists without ML expertise to build surrogates.

entry.title: Fully Homomorphic Encryption on Llama 3 model for privacy preserving LLM inference

author.name: Anes Abdennebi, Nadjia Kara, Laaziz Lahlou

entry.summary: Applies Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) to Llama 3 for privacy-preserving LLM inference, addressing data exposure risks in enterprise LLM deployments.

entry.title: LLM-Guided Semantic Bootstrapping for Interpretable Text Classification with Tsetlin Machines

author.name: Jiechao Gao, Rohan Kumar Yadav, Yuangang Li, Yuandong Pan, Jie Wang, Ying Liu, Michael Lepech

entry.summary: Proposes a semantic bootstrapping framework that transfers LLM knowledge into interpretable Tsetlin Machine representations through synthetic data generation, combining LLM semantic capacity with symbolic interpretability.

entry.title: ARGOS: Who, Where, and When in Agentic Multi-Camera Person Search

author.name: Myungchul Kim, Kwanyong Park, Junmo Kim, In So Kweon

entry.summary: ARGOS introduces the first benchmark reformulating multi-camera person search as an interactive reasoning problem where an agent must plan, question, and eliminate candidates using a spatio-temporal topology graph.

entry.title: Loop Corrections to the Training and Generalization Errors of Random Feature Models

author.name: Taeyoung Kim

entry.summary: Studies random feature models through a statistical physics lens, deriving loop corrections to training/test/generalization errors beyond mean-kernel approximation, obtaining finite-width scaling laws.

entry.title: Distorted or Fabricated? A Survey on Hallucination in Video LLMs

author.name: Yiyang Huang, Yitian Zhang, Yizhou Wang, Mingyuan Zhang, Liang Shi, Huimin Zeng, Yun Fu

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey on hallucinations in Video LLMs, introducing a taxonomy of dynamic distortion and content fabrication, reviewing evaluation benchmarks, metrics, and mitigation strategies.

entry.title: UCS: Estimating Unseen Coverage for Improved In-Context Learning

author.name: Jiayi Xin, Xiang Li, Evan Qiang, Weiqing He, Tianqi Shang, Weijie J. Su, Qi Long

entry.summary: UCS proposes Unseen Coverage Selection for in-context learning demonstrations, using Good-Turing estimation to select examples that maximize coverage of unseen latent clusters.

entry.title: SOLARIS: Speculative Offloading of Latent-bAsed Representation for Inference Scaling

author.name: Zikun Liu, Liang Luo, Qianru Li, Zhengyu Zhang, Wei Ling, Jingyi Shen, Zeliang Chen, Yaning Huang, Jingxian Huang, Abdallah Aboelela, Chonglin Sun, Feifan Gu, Fenggang Wu, Hang Qu, Huayu Li, Jill Pan, Kaidi Pei, Laming Chen, Longhao Jin, Qin Huang, Tongyi Tang, Varna Puvvada, Wenlin Chen, Xiaohan Wei, Xu Cao, Yantao Yao, Yuan Jin, Yunchen Pu, Yuxin Chen, Zijian Shen, Zhengkai Zhang, Dong Liang, Ellie Wen

entry.summary: SOLARIS applies speculative decoding ideas to recommendation systems, precomputing user-item embeddings for predicted future requests to enable real-time serving of complex foundation models.

entry.title: PrivEraserVerify: Efficient, Private, and Verifiable Federated Unlearning

author.name: Parthaw Goswami, Md Khairul Islam, Ashfak Yeafi

entry.summary: Presents PrivEraserVerify (PEV), a unified federated unlearning framework that combines efficiency, differential privacy protection, and verifiability—three properties previously addressed only in isolation by existing methods.

entry.title: Training single-electron and single-photon stochastic physical neural networks

author.name: Tong Dou, Shiro Kumara, Josh Burns, Ethan Sigler, Parth Girdhar, David Petty, Gerard Milburn, Jo Plested, Matt Woolley

entry.summary: Proposes novel electronic (single-electron tunneling) and photonic (single-photon) stochastic neurons for physical neural networks, demonstrating training methods for these quantum-scale computing elements.

entry.title: Information-Geometric Decomposition of Generalization Error in Unsupervised Learning

author.name: Gilhan Kim

entry.summary: Decomposes KL generalization error in unsupervised learning into model error, data bias, and variance using information geometry. Demonstrates on ε-PCA as an analytically tractable example.

entry.title: Cross-Domain Transfer with Particle Physics Foundation Models: From Jets to Neutrino Interactions

author.name: Gregor Krzmanc, Vinicius Mikuni, Benjamin Nachman, Callum Wilkinson

entry.summary: Demonstrates that the OmniLearned foundation model pre-trained on high-energy particle physics data can transfer effectively to few-GeV neutrino experiments, showing improved performance with less data.

entry.title: Generative Anonymization in Event Streams

author.name: Adam T. M\"uller, Mihai Kocsis, Nicolaj C. Stache

entry.summary: Presents the first generative anonymization framework for event camera streams, resolving the utility-privacy trade-off by anonymizing identities while preserving spatio-temporal structure for downstream tasks.

entry.title: Transforming External Knowledge into Triplets for Enhanced Retrieval in RAG of LLMs

author.name: Xudong Wang, Chaoning Zhang, Qigan Sun, Zhenzhen Huang, Chang Lu, Sheng Zheng, Zeyu Ma, Caiyan Qin, Yang Yang, Hengtao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes Tri-RAG, which transforms retrieved external knowledge into structured triplets for RAG, aiming to reduce redundancy and improve semantic alignment compared to concatenating unstructured text fragments.

entry.title: Multilingual Multi-Label Emotion Classification at Scale with Synthetic Data

author.name: Vadim Borisov

entry.summary: Constructs a large-scale synthetic multilingual multi-label emotion classification corpus of 1M+ samples across 23 languages with culturally-adapted generation. Trains and compares six multilingual transformer encoders from 135M to 560M parameters.

entry.title: SceneCritic: A Symbolic Evaluator for 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis

author.name: Kathakoli Sengupta, Kai Ao, Paola Cascante-Bonilla

entry.summary: Introduces SceneCritic, a symbolic evaluator for indoor scene layouts grounded in SceneOnto, a spatial ontology constructed from 3D-FRONT and other datasets. Provides stable, deterministic evaluation independent of viewpoint and rendering.

entry.title: V-Nutri: Dish-Level Nutrition Estimation from Egocentric Cooking Videos

author.name: Chengkun Yue, Chuanzhi Xu, Jiangpeng He

entry.summary: Proposes V-Nutri for dish-level nutrition estimation from egocentric cooking videos rather than single images of completed dishes. Establishes the first benchmark for video-based nutrition estimation using HD-EPIC dataset annotations.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving Structureless Visual Localization via Image Obfuscation

author.name: Vojtech Panek, Patrik Beliansky, Zuzana Kukelova, Torsten Sattler

entry.summary: Considers structureless visual localization methods for privacy preservation, where scenes are represented through reference images rather than 3D point clouds. Proposes image obfuscation techniques to prevent privacy leakage.

entry.title: VidTAG: Temporally Aligned Video to GPS Geolocalization with Denoising Sequence Prediction at a Global Scale

author.name: Parth Parag Kulkarni, Rohit Gupta, Prakash Chandra Chhipa, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Proposes VidTAG for video geolocalization via frame-to-GPS retrieval using both self-supervised and language-aligned features. Uses denoising sequence prediction to address temporal inconsistencies in video predictions.

entry.title: ArtifactWorld: Scaling 3D Gaussian Splatting Artifact Restoration via Video Generation Models

author.name: Xinliang Wang, Yifeng Shi, Zhenyu Wu

entry.summary: Proposes ArtifactWorld for 3DGS artifact restoration using video generation models with a fine-grained taxonomy of artifacts and a homogeneous dual-model paradigm. Addresses data bottleneck for training artifact repair.

entry.title: DreamStereo: Towards Real-Time Stereo Inpainting for HD Videos

author.name: Yuan Huang, Sijie Zhao, Jing Cheng, Hao Xu, Shaohui Jiao

entry.summary: Introduces DreamStereo for real-time stereo video inpainting of HD content, addressing data scarcity and computational redundancy. Three interconnected components handle dataset creation, efficient processing, and quality.

entry.title: RSGMamba: Reliability-Aware Self-Gated State Space Model for Multimodal Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Guoan Xu, Yang Xiao, Guangwei Gao, Dongchen Zhu, Wenjing Jia, Guo-Jun Qi

entry.summary: Proposes RSGMamba for multimodal semantic segmentation with explicit modality reliability modeling. Uses Reliability-aware Self-Gated Mamba Block to dynamically adjust fusion based on modality quality.

entry.title: Evolution-Inspired Sample Competition for Deep Neural Network Optimization

author.name: Ying Zheng, Yiyi Zhang, Yi Wang, Lap-Pui Chau

entry.summary: Proposes Natural Selection (NS), an evolution-inspired training method that models competitive interactions among samples to address class imbalance, hard samples, and noisy samples in deep learning.

entry.title: PDF-GS: Progressive Distractor Filtering for Robust 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Kangmin Seo, MinKyu Lee, Tae-Young Kim, ByeongCheol Lee, JoonSeoung An, Jae-Pil Heo

entry.summary: Proposes PDF-GS, a progressive distractor filtering framework for robust 3D Gaussian Splatting that exploits the inherent self-filtering property of 3DGS through multi-phase optimization.

entry.title: Scaling In-Context Segmentation with Hierarchical Supervision

author.name: T. Camaret Ndir, Marco Reisert, Robin T. Schirrmeister

entry.summary: Proposes PatchICL, a hierarchical framework for in-context medical image segmentation that learns to attend only to informative anatomical regions, improving scalability over global cross-attention approaches.

entry.title: Representing 3D Faces with Learnable B-Spline Volumes

author.name: Prashanth Chandran, Daoye Wang, Timo Bolkart

entry.summary: Presents CUBE, a B-spline volume representation with learned high-dimensional control features for 3D face modeling, demonstrating use in scan registration and monocular 3D face reconstruction.

entry.title: Radar-Camera BEV Multi-Task Learning with Cross-Task Attention Bridge for Joint 3D Detection and Segmentation

author.name: Ahmet \.Inan\c{c}, \"Ozg\"ur Erkent

entry.summary: Proposes CTAB, a bidirectional cross-task attention module for radar-camera BEV perception that exchanges features between detection and segmentation branches via multi-scale deformable attention.

entry.title: Pi-HOC: Pairwise 3D Human-Object Contact Estimation

author.name: Sravan Chittupalli, Ayush Jain, Dong Huang

entry.summary: Introduces Pi-HOC, a single-pass framework for dense 3D semantic contact prediction of all human-object pairs in images, handling multi-person scenarios without requiring object meshes.

entry.title: Direct Discrepancy Replay: Distribution-Discrepancy Condensation and Manifold-Consistent Replay for Continual Face Forgery Detection

author.name: Tianshuo Zhang, Haoyuan Zhang, Siran Peng, Weisong Zhao, Xiangyu Zhu, Zhen Lei

entry.summary: Proposes Direct Discrepancy Replay for continual face forgery detection, directly condensing forgery distributions for replay rather than storing samples or generating from decision boundaries.

entry.title: See, Point, Refine: Multi-Turn Approach to GUI Grounding with Visual Feedback

author.name: Himangi Mittal, Gaurav Mittal, Nelson Daniel Troncoso, Yu Hu

entry.summary: Empirical study of iterative GUI grounding with visual feedback for pixel-precise cursor localization in coding environments, showing multi-turn refinement improves accuracy over single-shot prediction.

entry.title: PAINT: Partner-Agnostic Intent-Aware Cooperative Transport with Legged Robots

author.name: Zhihao Cao, Tianxu An, Chenhao Li, Stelian Coros, Marco Hutter

entry.summary: PAINT is a hierarchical learning framework for partner-agnostic collaborative legged robot transport that infers partner intent from proprioceptive feedback alone, without requiring partner identification or communication.

entry.title: Robust Explanations for User Trust in Enterprise NLP Systems

author.name: Guilin Zhang, Kai Zhao, Jeffrey Friedman, Xu Chu, Amine Anoun, Jerry Ting

entry.summary: Proposes a unified black-box robustness evaluation framework for token-level NLP explanations, testing stability under realistic perturbations across encoder classifiers and decoder LLMs in enterprise deployment settings.

entry.title: X-VC: Zero-shot Streaming Voice Conversion in Codec Space

author.name: Qixi Zheng, Yuxiang Zhao, Tianrui Wang, Wenxi Chen, Kele Xu, Yikang Li, Qinyuan Chen, Xipeng Qiu, Kai Yu, Xie Chen

entry.summary: Presents X-VC, a zero-shot streaming voice conversion system that operates in neural codec latent space, achieving both high-fidelity speaker transfer and low-latency streaming through dual-conditioning and one-step conversion.

entry.title: Forecasting the Past: Gradient-Based Distribution Shift Detection in Trajectory Prediction

author.name: Michele De Vita, Julian Wiederer, Vasileios Belagiannis

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised method for detecting distribution shifts in trajectory prediction for autonomous driving. Uses gradient norms from a post-hoc decoder forecasting observed trajectories to score distribution shifts.

entry.title: RMGS-SLAM: Real-time Multi-sensor Gaussian Splatting SLAM

author.name: Dongen Li, Yi Liu, Junqi Liu, Zewen Sun, Zefan Huang, Shuo Sun, Jiahui Liu, Chengran Yuan, Hongliang Guo, Francis E. H. Tay, Marcelo H. Ang Jr

entry.summary: Presents a tightly coupled LiDAR-Inertial-Visual 3DGS-based SLAM framework for real-time photorealistic mapping in large-scale environments, parallelizing state estimation with Gaussian optimization.

entry.title: TCL: Enabling Fast and Efficient Cross-Hardware Tensor Program Optimization via Continual Learning

author.name: Chaoyao Shen, Linfeng Jiang, Yixian Shen, Tao Xu, Guoqing Li, Anuj Pathania, Andy D. Pimentel, Meng Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces TCL, a continual learning framework for cross-hardware tensor program optimization in DL compilers, using active learning to select just 10% of programs while maintaining optimization quality.

entry.title: XRZero-G0: Pushing the Frontier of Dexterous Robotic Manipulation with Interfaces, Quality and Ratios

author.name: Junming Wang, Teng Pu, Wingmun Fung, Jindong Wang, Shanchang Wang, Yuan Deng, Shuyuan Wang, Ziwei Liu, Kunhao Pan, Ping Yang, Peng Zhai, Yuxin Liang, Xiaofan Li, Jiabi Sun, Renchao Xu, Xiaotian Tian, Pengfei Yan, Guoqiang Ye, Liang Li, Qian Wang, Ruyi Gan, Hao Wang

entry.summary: Hardware-software co-designed system for collecting high-quality robotic manipulation demonstration data using VR interfaces with ergonomic grippers, plus systematic data-mixing strategies for policy learning.

entry.title: Identity as Attractor: Geometric Evidence for Persistent Agent Architecture in LLM Activation Space

author.name: Vladimir Vasilenko

entry.summary: Investigates whether identity documents of persistent cognitive agents create attractor-like behavior in LLM activation space. Shows paraphrases of agent identity converge to tighter clusters than controls across Llama 3.1 and Gemma 2 models.

entry.title: How memory can affect collective and cooperative behaviors in an LLM-Based Social Particle Swarm

author.name: Taisei Hishiki, Takaya Arita, Reiji Suzuki

entry.title: A Two-Stage LLM Framework for Accessible and Verified XAI Explanations

author.name: Georgios Mermigkis, Dimitris Metaxakis, Marios Tyrovolas, Argiris Sofotasios, Nikolaos Avgeris, Panagiotis Hadjidoukas, Chrysostomos Stylios

entry.summary: Proposes a Two-Stage LLM Meta-Verification Framework for XAI explanations, with an Explainer LLM generating narratives and a Verifier LLM assessing faithfulness, coherence, and completeness before user delivery.

entry.title: Transferable Expertise for Autonomous Agents via Real-World Case-Based Learning

author.name: Zhenyu Ma, Yuyang Song, Chunyi Yang, Jingyi Zhu, Letian Yang, Xukai Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes a case-based learning framework for LLM agents that converts past task experience into reusable knowledge assets, enabling transfer of analytical prompts and operational skills to new tasks.

entry.title: DBGL: Decay-aware Bipartite Graph Learning for Irregular Medical Time Series Classification

author.name: Jian Chen, Yuzhu Hu, Xiaoyan Yuan, Yuxuan Hu, Jinfeng Xu, Yipeng Du, Wenhao Yuan, Wei Wang, Edith C. H. Ngai

entry.summary: Introduces DBGL, a decay-aware bipartite graph learning method for irregular medical time series that captures both temporal sampling irregularity and variable decay patterns using a patient-variable bipartite graph structure.

entry.title: LLMs Struggle with Abstract Meaning Comprehension More Than Expected

author.name: Hamoud Alhazmi, Jiachen Jiang

entry.title: SpanKey: Dynamic Key Space Conditioning for Neural Network Access Control

author.name: WenBin Yan

entry.summary: Introduces SpanKey, a lightweight method to gate neural network inference using secret keys by conditioning activations on key subspaces, with analysis of failure modes including 'key absorption'.

entry.title: Black-Box Optimization From Small Offline Datasets via Meta Learning with Synthetic Tasks

author.name: Azza Fadhel, The Hung Tran, Trong Nghia Hoang, Jana Doppa

entry.summary: Proposes using synthetic task generation with optimization bias for offline black-box optimization from small datasets, using meta-learning to improve surrogate model ranking ability.

entry.title: FRTSearch: Unified Detection and Parameter Inference of Fast Radio Transients using Instance Segmentation

author.name: Bin Zhang, Yabiao Wang, Xiaoyao Xie, Shanping You, Xuhong Yu, Qiuhua Li, Hongwei Li, Shaowen Du, Chenchen Miao, Dengke Zhou, Jianhua Fang, Jiafu Wu, Pei Wang, Di Li

entry.title: From Kinematics to Dynamics: Learning to Refine Hybrid Plans for Physically Feasible Execution

author.name: Lidor Erez, Shahaf S. Shperberg, Ayal Taitler

entry.summary: Addresses the gap between kinematic planning and dynamic execution in robotics by learning to refine hybrid plans to ensure physical feasibility, handling constraints like deadlines and velocity limits.

entry.title: KG-Reasoner: A Reinforced Model for End-to-End Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph Reasoning

author.name: Shuai Wang, Yinan Yu

entry.summary: KG-Reasoner proposes an end-to-end reinforcement learning approach for multi-hop knowledge graph reasoning, replacing fixed pipeline decompositions with a unified framework that improves reasoning flexibility and coherence.

entry.title: Learning Chain Of Thoughts Prompts for Predicting Entities, Relations, and even Literals on Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Alkid Baci, Luke Friedrichs, Caglar Demir, N'Dah Jean Kouagou, Axel-Cyrille Ngonga Ngomo

entry.title: CLASP: Class-Adaptive Layer Fusion and Dual-Stage Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Yunkai Dang, Yizhu Jiang, Yifan Jiang, Qi Fan, Yinghuan Shi, Wenbin Li, Yang Gao

entry.summary: CLASP reduces visual token redundancy in multimodal LLMs through class-adaptive multi-layer vision feature fusion and dual-stage pruning, allocating tokens between attention-salient and diversity-preserving roles.

entry.title: Uncertainty Quantification in CNN Through the Bootstrap of Convex Neural Networks

author.name: Hongfei Du, Emre Barut, Fang Jin

entry.summary: Proposes a bootstrap-based uncertainty quantification framework for CNNs using convexified neural networks to establish theoretical consistency guarantees, with lower computational cost than ensemble methods.

entry.title: Exploring Concept Subspace for Self-explainable Text-Attributed Graph Learning

author.name: Xiaoxue Han, Libo Zhang, Zining Zhu, Yue Ning

entry.summary: Graph Concept Bottleneck maps graphs into a concept subspace of meaningful phrases for self-explainable text-attributed graph learning, using information bottleneck to refine concepts.

entry.title: Offline-Online Reinforcement Learning for Linear Mixture MDPs

author.name: Zhongjun Zhang, Sean R. Sinclair

entry.summary: Studies offline-online RL in linear mixture MDPs with environment shift, proposing an algorithm that adaptively leverages offline data when informative and safely ignores it when not.

entry.title: Identifying and Mitigating Gender Cues in Academic Recommendation Letters: An Interpretability Case Study

author.name: Charlotte S. Alexander, Shane Storks, Souradip Pal, Sayak Chakrabarty, Arushi Sharma, Mlen-Too Wesley, Bailey Russo

entry.title: Rethinking the Personalized Relaxed Initialization in the Federated Learning: Consistency and Generalization

author.name: Li Shen, Yan Sun, Dacheng Tao

entry.title: Inverse Design of Inorganic Compounds with Generative AI

author.name: Hannes Kneiding, Luc\'ia Mor\'an-Gonz\'alez, Nishamol Kuriakose, Ainara Nova, David Balcells

entry.summary: Reviews the application of generative AI methods for inverse design of inorganic compounds, covering molecules, crystals, transition metal complexes, and microporous materials.

entry.title: Physics-Grounded Monocular Vehicle Distance Estimation Using Standardized License Plate Typography

entry.title: Detecting Precise Hand Touch Moments in Egocentric Video

author.name: Yeeun Park, Miqdad Naduthodi, Suryansh Kumar

entry.title: AbdomenGen: Sequential Volume-Conditioned Diffusion Framework for Abdominal Anatomy Generation

author.name: Yubraj Bhandari, Lavsen Dahal, Paul Segars, Joseph Y. Lo

author.name: Mia-Katrin Kvalsund, James Stovold

entry.summary: Presents a rigorous dynamical systems analysis of Neural Cellular Automata attractors, examining stability, chaos, and perturbation response using tools from dynamical systems theory.

entry.title: 3DRO: Lidar-level SE(3) Direct Radar Odometry Using a 2D Imaging Radar and a Gyroscope

author.name: Cedric Le Gentil, Daniil Lisus, Timothy D. Barfoot

entry.title: From edges to meaning: Semantic line sketches as a cognitive scaffold for ancient pictograph invention

author.name: Seowung Leem (J. Crayton Pruitt Family Dept. of Biomedical Engineering, University of Florida, Gainesville, FL, USA), Lin Gu (Research Institute of Electrical Communication, Tohoku University, Japan), Ruogu Fang (J. Crayton Pruitt Family Dept. of Biomedical Engineering, University of Florida, Gainesville, FL, USA, Dept. of Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Florida, Gainesville, FL, USA, Dept. of Computer and Information Science and Engineering, University of Florida, Gainesville, FL, USA, Center for Cognitive Aging and Memory, University of Florida, Gainesville, FL, USA)

entry.title: Modeling Co-Pilots for Text-to-Model Translation

entry.title: PR-MaGIC: Prompt Refinement Via Mask Decoder Gradient Flow For In-Context Segmentation

author.name: Minjae Lee, Sungwoo Hur, Soojin Hwang, Won Hwa Kim

author.name: SungHo Kim, Juhyeong Park, Eda Atalay, SangKeun Lee

entry.title: Topology-Aware Reasoning over Incomplete Knowledge Graph with Graph-Based Soft Prompting

author.name: Fan Zhang, Shiming Fan, Hua Wang

entry.title: BID-LoRA: A Parameter-Efficient Framework for Continual Learning and Unlearning

author.name: Jagadeesh Rachapudi, Ritali Vatsi, Praful Hambarde, Amit Shukla

entry.summary: BID-LoRA formalizes Continual Learning-Unlearning as a unified paradigm, identifying knowledge leakage in naive combinations and proposing a LoRA-based framework for precise deletion and efficient learning.

entry.title: Efficient Adversarial Training via Criticality-Aware Fine-Tuning

author.name: Wenyun Li, Zheng Zhang, Dongmei Jiang, Yaowei Wang, Xiangyuan Lan

entry.summary: Proposes efficient adversarial training via criticality-aware fine-tuning of ViTs, identifying and robustly fine-tuning only a small subset of critical parameters to match full adversarial training performance.

entry.title: Decentralized Learning via Random Walk with Jumps

author.name: Zonghong Liu, Matthew Dwyer, Salim El Rouayheb

entry.summary: Identifies 'entrapment' phenomenon in decentralized learning with weighted random walks and proposes random walk with jumps to escape, providing convergence guarantees.

entry.title: RoleMAG: Learning Neighbor Roles in Multimodal Graphs

author.name: Yilong Zuo, Xunkai Li, Zhihan Zhang, Ronghua Li, Guoren Wang

entry.title: Is Sliding Window All You Need? An Open Framework for Long-Sequence Recommendation

author.name: Sayak Chakrabarty, Souradip Pal

entry.title: EEG-Based Multimodal Learning via Hyperbolic Mixture-of-Curvature Experts

entry.summary: Proposes a hyperbolic mixture-of-curvature experts approach for EEG-based multimodal learning, leveraging the natural hierarchical structure of EEG and associated modalities in hyperbolic space.

entry.title: Refined Differentially Private Linear Regression via Extension of a Free Lunch Result

author.name: Sasmita Harini S, Anshoo Tandon

entry.title: Fine-tuning Factor Augmented Neural Lasso for Heterogeneous Environments

author.name: Jinhang Chai, Jianqing Fan, Cheng Gao, Qishuo Yin

entry.summary: Introduces fine-tuning Factor Augmented Neural Lasso (FAN-Lasso), a transfer learning framework for high-dimensional nonparametric regression with variable selection that handles covariate and posterior shifts.

entry.title: Representing expertise accelerates learning from pedagogical interaction data

author.name: Dhara Yu, Karthikeya Kaushik, Bill D. Thompson

entry.title: EvoSpark: Endogenous Interactive Agent Societies for Unified Long-Horizon Narrative Evolution

author.name: Shiyu He, Minchi Kuang, Mengxian Wang, Bin Hu, Tingxiang Gu

entry.summary: Proposes EvoSpark for sustaining coherent long-horizon narratives in LLM-based multi-agent systems. Addresses social memory stacking and narrative-spatial dissonance through Stratified Narrative Memory and other mechanisms.

entry.title: Redefining Quality Criteria and Distance-Aware Score Modeling for Image Editing Assessment

author.name: Xinjie Zhang, Qiang Li, Xiaowen Ma, Axi Niu, Li Yan, Qingsen Yan

entry.summary: Proposes DS-IEQA for image editing quality assessment that jointly learns evaluation criteria and score representations. Uses feedback-driven metric prompt optimization and distance-aware score modeling.

author.name: Qingyuan Cai, Saihui Hou, Xuecai Hu, Yongzhen Huang

entry.title: Modality-Agnostic Prompt Learning for Multi-Modal Camouflaged Object Detection

entry.title: DPC-VQA: Decoupling Quality Perception and Residual Calibration for Video Quality Assessment

author.name: Xinyue Li, Shubo Xu, Zhichao Zhang, Zhaolin Cai, Yitong Chen, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: Proposes DPC-VQA, a framework that uses a frozen MLLM for base video quality estimation and a lightweight calibration branch for residual correction, avoiding expensive retraining for new VQA scenarios.

entry.title: CoSyncDiT: Cognitive Synchronous Diffusion Transformer for Movie Dubbing

author.name: Gaoxiang Cong, Liang Li, Jiaxin Ye, Zhedong Zhang, Hongming Shan, Yuankai Qi, Qingming Huang

entry.summary: Proposes CoSync-DiT for movie dubbing, using flow matching and a cognitive synchronization architecture inspired by professional actors to achieve lip-sync speech synthesis from reference audio.

entry.title: Ternary Logic Encodings of Temporal Behavior Trees with Application to Control Synthesis

author.name: Ryan Matheu, John S. Baras, Calin Belta

entry.title: DeCoNav: Dialog enhanced Long-Horizon Collaborative Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Sunyao Zhou, Yunzi Wu, Tianhang Wang, Xinhai Li, Guang Chen, Lizheng Liu, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Presents DeCoNav, a dialog-enhanced framework for long-horizon collaborative vision-language navigation with multiple robots. Adds synchronized dual-robot rollout and adaptive coordination through inter-agent dialog.

entry.title: Tree Learning: A Multi-Skill Continual Learning Framework for Humanoid Robots

author.name: Yifei Yan, Linqi Ye

entry.title: Human-Inspired Context-Selective Multimodal Memory for Social Robots

author.name: Hangyeol Kang, Slava Voloshynovskiy, Nadia Magnenat Thalmann

entry.summary: Proposes a context-selective multimodal memory architecture for social robots inspired by cognitive neuroscience, capturing textual and visual episodic traces prioritized by emotional salience or scene novelty for personalized interactions.

entry.title: TRUST Agents: A Collaborative Multi-Agent Framework for Fake News Detection, Explainable Verification, and Logic-Aware Claim Reasoning

author.name: Gautama Shastry Bulusu Venkata, Santhosh Kakarla, Maheedhar Omtri Mohan, Aishwarya Gaddam

entry.title: Artificial Intelligence for Modeling and Simulation of Mixed Automated and Human Traffic

author.name: Saeed Rahmani, Shiva Rasouli, Daphne Cornelisse, Eugene Vinitsky, Bart van Arem, Simeon C. Calvert

entry.title: Thermodynamic Liquid Manifold Networks: Physics-Bounded Deep Learning for Solar Forecasting in Autonomous Off-Grid Microgrids

author.name: Mohammed Ezzaldin Babiker Abdullah

entry.title: INDOTABVQA: A Benchmark for Cross-Lingual Table Understanding in Bahasa Indonesia Documents

author.name: Somraj Gautam, Anathapindika Dravichi, Gaurav Harit

entry.summary: Introduces INDOTABVQA, a cross-lingual Table VQA benchmark for Bahasa Indonesia documents with 1,593 images and QA sets in four languages, revealing substantial performance gaps in current VLMs on structurally complex tables.

entry.title: ARGen: Affect-Reinforced Generative Augmentation towards Vision-based Dynamic Emotion Perception

author.name: Huanzhen Wang, Ziheng Zhou, Jiaqi Song, Li He, Yunshi Lan, Yan Wang, Wenqiang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes ARGen, a two-stage framework for dynamic facial expression recognition that uses affect-reinforced generative augmentation to address data scarcity and long-tail distributions of emotional expressions.

entry.title: GCA Framework: A Gulf-Grounded Dataset and Agentic Pipeline for Climate Decision Support

author.name: Muhammad Umer Sheikh, Khawar Shehzad, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Muhammad Haris Khan

entry.summary: Presents the GCA framework combining a Gulf-focused climate dataset (~200K QA pairs) with a tool-augmented agent for climate analysis in the Gulf region, integrating policy documents, academic literature, and geospatial tools.

entry.title: GeM-EA: A Generative and Meta-learning Enhanced Evolutionary Algorithm for Streaming Data-Driven Optimization

author.name: Yue Wu, Yuan-Ting Zhong, Ze-Yuan Ma, Yue-Jiao Gong

entry.title: Euler-inspired Decoupling Neural Operator for Efficient Pansharpening

entry.title: Social Learning Strategies for Evolved Virtual Soft Robots

author.name: K. Ege de Bruin, Kyrre Glette, Kai Olav Ellefsen, Giorgia Nadizar, Eric Medvet

entry.title: When Does Data Augmentation Help? Evaluating LLM and Back-Translation Methods for Hausa and Fongbe NLP

author.name: Mahounan Pericles Adjovi, Roald Eiselen, Prasenjit Mitra
